jobs.title: Strategy & Transformation Senior Consultant
IT Business Consultant (Manager-Program Manager)
jobs.description:
Job Duties and Responsibilities

職務内容

製造業、自動車、エネルギー、ライフサイエンス業界のクライアントに対し、デジタルトランスフォーメーション（DX）施策およびグローバルIT戦略の実行をリードする経験豊富な人材を募集しています

本ポジションでは、経営層との折衝、エンドツーエンドの変革プログラムの設計・推進、コンサルティングチームのマネジメントを通じて、クライアントに大きな価値を提供していただきます

主な業務内容

- デジタル技術を活用した全社変革戦略の策定および実行

- グローバルIT組織の設計、およびITインフラ導入プロジェクトの企画・推進

- コンサルティングチームのリードおよび人材育成

- スマートファクトリー、IoT／IoS、PMI（買収後統合）などの先進的な取り組みの提案・実行

- クライアントとの長期的な関係構築、および戦略アカウントの拡大

提供サービス

1. コンサルティング

ビジネスモデル設計、業務改革（BPR）、システムアーキテクチャ構想策定、チェンジマネジメントを含む包括的な支援を提供します

2. ITソリューションサービス

オンショア／オフショア体制を活用したIT導入、開発・テスト支援、グローバルITプラットフォーム構築を提供します

3. ITサポートサービス

ニアショア／オフショアリソースを活用し、コスト最適化、スケーラビリティ向上、リスク低減を実現するIT運用支援を提供します

プロジェクト事例

- 製造業向けITコスト最適化のための戦略立案および実行支援

- 組織再編時におけるグローバルIT本社機能の設計、および戦略的拠点の選定支援

- 設備・素材領域における業務プロセスの標準化およびシステム導入支援

We are seeking experienced professionals to lead digital transformation initiatives and global IT strategy execution for clients in the manufacturing, automotive, energy, and life sciences industries . This role involves engaging with executive stakeholders, designing and driving end-to-end transformation programs, and managing consulting teams to deliver impactful results.

Position: Manager to Program Manager

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute enterprise transformation strategies leveraging digital technologies

- Design and manage global IT organizations and infrastructure implementation projects

- Lead consulting teams and foster talent development

- Propose and implement advanced initiatives such as smart factories, IoT/IoS, and post-merger integration (PMI)

- Build long-term client relationships and expand strategic accounts

Service Offerings

-
Consulting
Comprehensive support for business model design, business process reengineering, system architecture planning, and change management

-
IT Solution Services
IT implementation, development, and testing support using onshore/offshore models; global IT platform development

-
IT Support Services
IT operations support leveraging nearshore/offshore resources to optimize cost, scalability, and risk mitigation

Project Examples

- Strategic planning and execution support for IT cost optimization in the manufacturing sector

- Designing global IT HQ functions and selecting strategic locations during organizational restructuring

- Standardizing business processes and implementing systems in equipment and materials domains

Qualification

【必須（MUST）】

主にコンサルティングファーム等にて ITビジネスコンサルタント としての職務経験をお持ちの方を募集しています。

マネージャー〜プログラムマネージャーレベルでのリーダーシップを発揮できる方を想定しています。

＜コンサルティングファーム／SIer出身者の場合＞

- コンサルティングファームまたはSIerにおける業務改善・ITシステム導入コンサルティングの経験

- 製造業、自動車、エネルギー、ライフサイエンス、化学業界クライアントとのプロジェクト経験

＜コンサルティング未経験者の場合＞

- 製造業、自動車、ユーティリティ、ライフサイエンス業界でのビジネス経験（特に製造プロセス、SCM、生産管理領域など業界専門性が高い方）

- グローバルビジネスの経験

【歓迎（WANT）】

- SAP（ERP）導入プロジェクト経験（特にMM、PP、SDモジュール）

- 高い英語力（グローバル連携が強い環境で活かせます）

- ユーティリティ業界（特に電力）での経験

【求める人物像／志向性】

- 常に新しいビジネスやITに関心を持ち、学び続ける好奇心旺盛な方

- 曖昧な状況をチャンスと捉え、創造的なアイデアを生み出すことが好きな方

- 高いコミットメント意識を持ち、困難な状況でも前向きにやり抜ける方

- 論理的思考力と仮説検証力を持ち、柔軟に情報を整理・活用し、課題解決に向けた提案ができる方

- 強いリーダーシップを発揮し、チームをまとめ上げる力のある方

- 多様な文化・価値観を持つチームで働くことに魅力を感じる方

- 世界42万人規模のグローバルファームでありながら、日本ではベンチャー的な成長環境に面白みを感じられる方

【Requirements – MUST】

We are seeking candidates with strong experience as  IT business consultants , particularly those who can lead transformation initiatives at the managerial level.

For candidates with consulting firm or SIer experience:

- Proven experience in business process improvement and IT system implementation consulting at a consulting firm or SIer

- Experience working with clients in the manufacturing, automotive, utilities, and life science sector

For candidates without consulting experience:

- Business experience in the manufacturing, automotive, utilities, or life sciences industries (especially in areas such as manufacturing processes, supply chain management, or production control)

- Experience in global business environments

Language:

- Native-level Japanese (Speaking, Writing, Reading)

- Business level English

【Preferred Qualifications – WANT】

- Experience in SAP (ERP) implementation projects, including business process improvement (especially in MM, PP, or SD modules)

- Strong English communication skills (to collaborate effectively in a global consulting environment)

- Experience in the utilities industry (especially electric power) is a plus

【Ideal Candidate Profile】

- Continuously curious and eager to explore new trends in business and IT

- Comfortable with ambiguity and able to generate creative, original ideas

- Highly committed, resilient, and able to maintain a positive attitude even under pressure

- Strong logical and hypothesis-driven thinking, with the ability to organize information, propose solutions, and adapt communication to different stakeholders

- Demonstrates strong leadership and team-building capabilities

- Enjoys working in diverse, multicultural teams

- Finds excitement in working within a global firm of 420,000+ employees while contributing to a still-growing, venture-like environment in Japan

jobs.title: IT Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Word een leidende kracht in service integratie! Sluit je aan als IT Management consultant en stuur complexe service-integratieprojecten aan voor toonaangevende klanten.

Jouw mogelijkheden als IT Management Consultant bij Capgemini

Vanwege de sterke groei van ons team en de toenemende vraag van onze klanten, zijn we op zoek naar IT Management Consultants om ons team te versterken. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service management en Service Integratie oplossingen. Je werkt samen met klanten en interne teams om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en best practices te implementeren. Je helpt bij het optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen en draagt zo bij aan het succes van onze klanten.

In het kort:

- Samenwerking: Werk nauw samen met consultants en ontwikkelaars om je kennis en vaardigheden te vergroten.

- Innovatie en Ontwikkeling: Neem deel aan het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen.

- Professionele Groei: Krijg de kans om deel te nemen aan design workshops, demo sessies, en vele interne opleidingsmogelijkheden bij onze Academie en interne opleidingsprogramma’s met de mogelijkheid tot het behalen van extern geaccrediteerde certificeringen. En bouw waardevolle relaties op met klanten en interne teams.

Jouw thuisbasis bij Capgemini

Internationale carrièremogelijkheden en fantastische expertise netwerken. Met meer dan 270.000 collega's wereldwijd en meer dan 7000 collega's alleen al in Nederland, word je omringd door een brede, technisch intensieve community van gemotiveerde collega's. Innovatieve, complexe- en uitdagende projecten voor bekende, vaak multinationale opdrachtgevers, ondersteund door wereld leidende partners en de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband bij een succesvolle internationale adviesorganisatie.

Het team waar je onderdeel van uit zult maken is verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van IT Management en Service Integratieoplossingen en biedt een breed scala aan diensten, van strategisch advies tot de levering en implementatie van projecten. Het team bestaat uit ervaren consultants die klanten adviseren bij het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service Management-oplossingen. Ze werken nauw samen met klanten om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en ondersteunen de ontwikkelaars en project- en commerciële teams. Daarnaast organiseren ze workshops met interne en externe stakeholders om de gebruikerservaring en acceptatie van het IT Service Management te verbeteren.

Benefits

- Direct een vast contract en een passend salaris.

-  Onbeperkt trainingen volgen bij onze  Academy .

- 26 vakantiedagen. Zin in een extra veel vrije tijd? Koop dan dagen bij.

- Capgemini draagt bij aan jouw pensioen. Daarnaast heb je ook de vrijheid om hier zelf nog extra aan bij te dragen.

- Werken waar je maar wilt met onze connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding (uiteraard in overleg met de opdrachtgever).

- Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken.

- Een leaseauto, NS-businesscard of uitbetaling van je reiskostenvergoeding.

- Werken bij de beste IT opleider van Nederland!

Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Als IT Management Consultant bij Capgemini speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service Management en Service Integration and Management-oplossingen, waardoor je direct bijdraagt aan het succes van onze klanten. Je werkt nauw samen met klanten en interne teams om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en best practices te verspreiden. Jouw bijdrage helpt ons bedrijven hun bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren en te transformeren.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief te kunnen samenwerken met klanten en interne teams.

- Kennis en ervaring met IT management, IT Governance, ITIL of andere beheer modellen. SIAM (Service Integration and Management) is een pre.

- Probleemoplossend vermogen om snel en creatief oplossingen te vinden voor complexe uitdagingen.

- Leergierigheid en bereid om continu te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een dynamische omgeving.

- Deze rol biedt je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen door bij verschillende klanten van Capgemini je kennis en ervaring te delen en te ontwikkelen.

Wil je meer weten?

Wil je solliciteren? Graag!

Eerst het team ontmoeten? Ook dat kan!

Je kunt onze recruiter Kim Landman (kim.a.landman@capgemini.com) e-mailen voor een orienterend gesprek, op kantoor of online.

jobs.title: Capgemini Invent -Sr. Project Management Consultant
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You're Considering

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities,   collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow.   Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About the Job

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI.

Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for experienced consultants who are passionate about helping organizations execute complex business and technology transformations. You will join our Transformation Management capability, helping clients establish governance, drive delivery excellence, manage execution risk, and realize value across large-scale transformation programs.

The Transformation Management capability focuses on program governance, PMO leadership, integrated planning, dependency management, value realization, and executive reporting. Our consultants help clients navigate complexity, align stakeholders, and accelerate transformation outcomes while leveraging AI-enabled ways of working to improve decision-making, transparency, and execution.

Your Role

- As a Senior PMO Transformation Consultant, you will play a key role in managing and delivering transformation programs by leading governance activities, driving program controls, and coordinating execution across multiple workstreams. You will work closely with client stakeholders, program leadership, and delivery teams to ensure alignment, visibility, and successful transformation outcomes.

- Lead core PMO and Transformation Management Office (TMO) activities across large-scale transformation programs.

- Develop and manage integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities.

- Own RAID processes, including risk identification, issue escalation, dependency management, and resolution tracking.

- Produce executive-level dashboards, status reports, and Steering Committee materials that drive leadership decision-making.

- Facilitate governance forums and ensure alignment across business, technology, and delivery teams.

- Monitor program performance, delivery health, and transformation outcomes through data-driven reporting and analysis.

- Drive accountability across workstreams by coordinating actions, decisions, and follow-up activities.

- Facilitate workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder discussions while translating outcomes into actionable plans.

- Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, analysis, knowledge management, and program coordination

jobs.title: BTP Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Long Description

Capgemini is seeking a highly skilled Senior SAP BTP / CPI Consultant with 6+ years of SAP experience and strong expertise in SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP Integration Suite (CPI). The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering integration and extension solutions across SAP and non-SAP landscapes while supporting large-scale digital transformation programs.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite (CPI).

- Build and support end-to-end integrations between SAP and third-party applications.

- Develop and maintain APIs, web services, and event-driven integrations.

- Design and develop iFlows, mappings, adapters, and monitoring solutions within SAP CPI.

- Collaborate with functional and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.

- Support SAP BTP services including Extension Suite, SAP Build, HANA Cloud, and Datasphere.

- Participate in solution design workshops and provide technical recommendations.

- Troubleshoot integration issues and optimize performance of existing interfaces.

- Ensure adherence to SAP best practices, security standards, and governance frameworks.

- Prepare technical documentation, deployment guides, and knowledge transfer materials.

- Mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability-building initiatives.

- Support proposal development, estimations, and presales activities when required.

Required Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of SAP experience, including at least 4+ years of hands-on experience in SAP BTP and SAP CPI.

- Strong experience with:

- SAP Integration Suite (CPI)

- SAP API Management

- SAP Event Mesh

- SAP Extension Suite

- SAP Business Application Studio

- SAP BTP Administration

- Hands-on experience integrating:

- SAP S/4HANA

- SAP SuccessFactors

- SAP Ariba

- SAP Concur

- SAP Fieldglass

- Non-SAP applications and cloud platforms

- Knowledge of integration patterns, middleware architecture, and API-led connectivity.

- Experience with XML, XSLT, JSON, REST, SOAP, OData, and IDoc technologies.

- Familiarity with JavaScript, Groovy scripting, and SQL.

- Strong understanding of authentication and security protocols such as OAuth, SAML, JWT, and certificates.

- Experience working within Agile and DevOps environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Integration Suite.

- SAP BTP Certification.

- Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.

- Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

- Consulting experience within a global systems integrator or multinational environment.

Soft Skills

- Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

- Ability to work independently and lead integration workstreams.

- Strong communication and presentation skills.

- Experience mentoring and guiding junior team members.

Why Join Capgemini?

- Work on global SAP transformation programs across multiple industries.

- Access to continuous learning, certifications, and career growth opportunities.

- Collaborate with leading SAP experts in a diverse and innovative environment.

- Contribute to cutting-edge cloud, integration, and digital transformation initiatives.

Job Description

SaaS Integration and Data Consultants use their expertise in package/SaaS-based integration and data-focused technologies along with their understanding of the data structures of the application package(s)/SaaS Solutions to support the need for data to accurately flow between different applications/systems in the client landscape. They are responsible for data modeling, design and realization of integrations, as well as testing, deployment and release management or technical and functional application management of integrations between client-specific package/SaaS based solutions and other systems.

Job Description - Grade Specific

Able to provide packageorSaaS based end to end integration solutions, Data modeling, Data Migration solutions. Able to manage multiple products under portfolio. Able to manage a large team and manage customer escalations. You have a leading role in projects with strong client exposure, and operate at a director level in major client organizations. You are responsible for technical guidance over the whole project or application lifecycle. Able to participate in bids and proposals. Able to manage the project financials.

jobs.title: Managing Consultant Organization, Purpose and Strategy
jobs.description:
Utrecht & hybride
32–40 uur

Ervaring: Managing Consultant (minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring)
Start met vast contract

Jouw impact als Managing Consultant OPS

Organisaties bewegen in hoog tempo mee met digitalisering, verduurzaming en een veranderende arbeidsmarkt. Als Managing Consultant binnen Organization, Purpose & Strategy (OPS) speel jij een sleutelrol in het vormgeven én realiseren van de strategie door het (her)ontwerpen van de organisatie en het begeleiden van transformaties. Je helpt klanten hun organisatie-inrichting, governance, cultuur en manier van werken toekomstbestendig te maken en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete veranderingen.

Jij brengt ervaring mee, denkt mee op strategisch niveau en bent in staat complexe uitdagingen te vertalen naar concrete transformaties.

Dit doe je bijvoorbeeld door operating models te herontwerpen, verandertrajecten te begeleiden rondom nieuwe processen en IT-platforms, en organisaties te ondersteunen bij de adoptie van oplossingen zoals SAP, Microsoft 365, Google of Atlassian. Je speelt in op ontwikkelingen zoals AI-gedreven transformatie, de groei van geïntegreerde digitale platformen en de beweging naar adaptieve, wendbare organisaties. Vanuit jouw expertise houd jij je bezig met (agile) organisatieontwerpen, effectieve portfoliosturing en het opschalen van nieuwe manieren van werken zodat teams en functies als geheel beter presteren.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden als Managing Consultant OPS

Als Managing Consultant:

· Ben je (mede-)verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en realiseren van complexe transformaties, van strategie tot implementatie.

· Houd je je bezig met het structuren en digitaliseren van kernprocessen van organisaties, of een nieuw organisatieonderdeel vormgeven.

· Heb je een leidende rol in het vormgeven van projectaanpak, managen van het projectteam, rapporteren op inhoudelijke voortgang en klantdialoog.

· Herken jij kansen waar wij de klant kunnen ondersteunen bij hun uitdagingen en vertaal je klantvragen naar transformatieprogramma’s die organisaties wendbaarder maken

· Ontwikkel en onderhoud je een klantennetwerk binnen een sector waarvoor je affiniteit hebt.

· Breng je organisatie- en transformatietrends in en help je deze door te vertalen naar onze OPS-thema’s zoals Business Agility en Strategic Organizational Design.

· Ken je de trends rondom AI en wat voor impact dit heeft op klanten.

· Coach je minder ervaren collega’s en draag je actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het OPS-team.

Geen dag is hetzelfde en dat maakt het werk uitdagend en leuk.

Je thuisbasis bij Capgemini Invent: Organization, Purpose & Strategy

Je werkt binnen het OPS-team, onderdeel van de Workforce & Organization practice. Een hecht, jong en ambitieus team van zo’n dertig collega’s dat werkt aan toonaangevende transformaties in voornamelijk de publieke sector, energy & utilities (ET&U) markt en de sector voor Consumer Products, Retail and Distribution (CPRD).

Wat je mag verwachten:

· Een team dat staat voor samenwerking, innovatie en elkaar verder helpen.

· Een internationaal netwerk in meer dan 50 landen.

· Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, coaching en professionele groei.

· Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, lunches en Invent-uitjes.

· Toegang tot onze actieve personeelsvereniging met o.a. filmavonden, ski-trips en een jaarlijkse zeilcompetitie.

jobs.title: Divisional Risk Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
Job Description

Position Overview

The Divisional Risk Operations Manager is a senior consultant who will support the Divisional Technology Risk
Operations Management Lead in executing workforce strategy, overseeing consulting engagements, advancing
organizational priorities, and driving operational excellence. The role will help establish, mature, and drive the
operational efficiency and enabling functions that support the Divisional Risk Management Practice, including
governance, workforce and vendor management, business planning, executive reporting, and process
improvement. This individual will serve as a hands-on strategic and operational partner, coordinating leadership
activities, facilitating key governance forums, and producing clear, executive-ready content and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

• Support workforce strategy, organizational design, resource planning, staffing analysis, and related
management activities.
• Coordinate the day-to-day management of active project consulting and managed services engagements,
including governance, financial tracking, performance monitoring, risks, issues, and stakeholder updates.
• Help translate organizational strategy into practical plans, milestones, governance routines, and measurable
outcomes.
• Establish, mature, and drive operational efficiency and enabling functions across the Divisional Risk
Management Practice, including standardized processes, governance routines, management information, and
continuous improvement mechanisms.
• Coordinate and facilitate quarterly Integrated Business Review (IBR) meetings, leadership reviews, planning
sessions, and other governance forums.
• Create executive-level presentations, briefing materials, dashboards, reports, talking points, and leadership
communications.
• Track strategic initiatives, commitments, decisions, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items to promote
visibility and accountability.
• Analyze operational performance, capacity, and organizational metrics to identify trends, gaps, and
improvement opportunities.
• Drive process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, transparency, and scalability across the
organization.
• Partner with senior leaders, functional teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to maintain alignment and
support timely execution of priorities.

Required Qualifications

• Significant experience in business operations, technology, technology risk, strategy execution, program
management, consulting, or a related field.
• Strong knowledge of technology organizations and technology risk concepts, including governance, operating
models, portfolio management, and organizational planning.
• Experience supporting workforce strategy, organizational design, resource planning, or vendor and consulting
engagement management.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into
concise, audience-appropriate messages.
Divisional Risk Operations Manager | Senior Consultant
• Demonstrated ability to create polished executive-level content, including presentations, reports, dashboards,
briefing materials, and leadership communications.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project coordination skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and drive progress in a fast-paced, matrixed
environment.
• Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with senior leaders, cross-functional
partners, consultants, and vendors.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and related productivity and reporting tools.
Preferred Experience
• Experience within enterprise technology, technology risk, cybersecurity, operational risk, or a regulated
financial services environment.
• Experience preparing materials for senior management, executive committees, or formal business reviews.
• Experience establishing or improving governance routines, management reporting, operational metrics, or
business processes.
Measures of Success

jobs.title: Senior Manager Consultant Change
jobs.description:
Als Senior Manager Consultant in het Program & Change Acceleration team help je klanten met het bereiken van de toekomst die zij voor ogen hebben in grootschalige verandertrajecten. Wij realiseren complexe transformaties met een focus op duurzame gedragsverandering. In deze rol houd je je bezig met het introduceren van nieuwe manieren van werken, komen tot adoptie, waarde realiseren en het meten en borgen van verandering. Zo begeleid je klanten bijvoorbeeld bij de implementatie van IT-systemen of naar ander gedrag. Zo weet jij de verandervisie te ontwerpen en bied je deskundig advies over de benodigde strategie en de uitvoering. Je bent veel bij klanten te vinden om teams van consultants te begeleiden en de kwaliteit van projecten te waarborgen, daarbij creëer je een inspirerende en fijne werkomgeving. Binnen het team helpen we elkaar graag. Je bent één van de drijvende krachten achter ons team. Je coacht collega’s in hun rol en draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen van nieuwe kennis en proposities op het gebied van change management.

- Uren: 32-40 uur

- Werkplek: Utrecht en remote

- Ervaring: senior

Jouw mogelijkheden als Senior Manager Consultant Change bij Capgemini Invent

Je bent onderdeel van Capgemini Invent, de managementconsulting tak van de Capgemini Group. Als Senior Managing Consultant Change realiseer je grootschalige verandertrajecten die van strategisch belang zijn voor (inter)nationaal opererende bedrijven zodat deze optimaal kunnen inspelen op digitale ontwikkelingen. Binnen het team van Program & Change Acceleration richten we ons op de combinatie van de volgende gebieden: digitale- en IT-transformaties, organisatorische verandering en gedragsverandering. Een voorbeeld is een organisatie die meer data-gedreven gaat werken en ons vraagt om te zorgen daarmee meer impact te maken. Je denkt mee over welke stappen en acties nodig zijn om verandering te realiseren. Je begeleidt teams en management tijdens transformaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat de resultaten van de verandering duurzaam zijn en je legt de basis voor continu verbeteren. Daarbij gebruiken we de nieuwste veranderkundige inzichten en digitale hulpmiddelen uit ons internationale Capgemini netwerk.

Als Senior Managing Consultant bij Program & Change Acceleration:

- Ontwikkel je veranderprogramma’s en manage je de uitvoering daarvan.

- Focus je op één of twee sectoren/klanten die passen bij jouw ervaring.

- Deel je jouw innovatieve visie, binnen en buiten de organisatie;

- Maak je complexe verandertrajecten tot een succes met een focus op organisatie, processen/systemen en mensen;

- Stuur je teams aan, die soms ook internationaal werken;

- Zet je jouw expertise over (gedrags-)verandering in om medewerkers voor te bereiden op transformaties in het digitale tijdperk;

- Blijf je op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van verandermanagement en deel je jouw kennis met collega’s en klanten;

- Begeleid je het Program & Change Acceleration team bij het ontwikkelen van methodes en tools voor klanten en interne ontwikkeling;

- Schrijf je mee aan proposals en draag je bij aan het realiseren van sales.

Je thuisbasis bij Capgemini Invent

Binnen het Program & Change Acceleration team werken we samen aan de toekomst van ons team. We helpen elkaar om succesvol te zijn bij klanten en gebruiken ook ons internationale netwerk van collega’s. We staan bekend om onze op maat gemaakte groeipaden en de persoonlijke begeleiding door counselors. Capgemini heeft verschillende netwerken en communities. Daarnaast zijn er de personeelsverenigingen Young Invent (voor young professionals) en Escape (Capgemini), die regelmatig diverse activiteiten organiseren, zoals sporttoernooien, game nights, borrels, een jaarlijkse zeilcompetitie en een wintersportvakantie naar Oostenrijk. Er is voor ieder wat wils en genoeg te doen dus!

Benefits

- Direct een vast contract en een passend salaris, op basis van ervaring tussen 5.300 en 6.500 bruto per maand.

- Een jaarlijkse bonus en een vakantietoeslag van 8%.

- Een mobiliteitsvergoeding van 900 euro per maand.

- Keuze uit een elektrische of hybride leaseauto, reizen met een NS-businesscard of uitbetaling van je mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Een ruim aanbod aan trainingen passend bij jouw rol en jouw doorontwikkeling.

- 26 vakantiedagen. Zin in extra veel vrije tijd? Koop dan dagen bij.

- Een pensioen waarvan het werkgeversaandeel volledig wordt betaald en de keuze om dat zelf aan te vullen.

- Werken waar je maar wilt met onze connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

- Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken.

Ben jij meer ervaren en past jouw salaris niet meer bovenstaande arbeidsvoorwaarden? Kijk dan naar onze vacatures voor meer ervaren management consultants (Director posities).

Waarom deze vacature bij jou past

Je wilt bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze producten en diensten op het gebied van verandermanagement. Je bent daadkrachtig in het realiseren van doelstellingen en schuwt de confrontatie niet wanneer nodig. Je kan goed met weerstand omgaan en ziet een uitdaging in het veranderen van zaken die niet goed gaan. Je bent analytisch en communicatief sterk; je kunt goed verbanden leggen, denkt gestructureerd en je kunt hoofd- en bijzaken makkelijk van elkaar scheiden. Je kan “out of the box” denken en doet dus ook alles wat nodig is om de verandering succesvol te laten zijn, wanneer extra coaching of een escalatie nodig is, dan ben jij bereid om dat ook te doen. Verder draag je ideeën aan, initieer je discussies en zorg je voor tempo. Jouw gedrevenheid slaat over op de mensen om je heen en je bent geïnteresseerd in wat mensen en groepen beweegt. Je hebt een data gedreven mindset en bent bereid om meer te leren over data gedreven verandermanagement. Ten slotte heb je affiniteit met veranderingen binnen een technische/IT context. Verder breng je het volgende mee:

- Ruim 9 jaar relevante (internationale) werkervaring gerelateerd aan verandermanagement en consultancy

- Afgeronde WO-opleiding, bij voorkeur een opleiding met een organisatorisch of business aspect.

- Diepgaande kennis van en ruime ervaring met het toepassen van verandermanagement methodieken en projectmanagement. Ervaring in een context van IT-veranderingen (bijv. implementatie SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, Workday, “journey to cloud”, automatisering etc.) en dan met name de impact hiervan op organisatie, processen, cultuur en werkwijze.

- Vaardigheid in het realiseren van complexe, grootschalige verandertrajecten met een internationaal karakter zoals digitale veranderingen, reorganisaties, implementaties en/of procesverbeteringen.

- Sterke ondernemersgeest en commerciële vaardigheden.

- Goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal. Een extra taal is natuurlijk mooi meegenomen.

- To be eligible for this role, you must work and live in The Netherlands. It is necessary to be able to speak Dutch (at least B2 level).

- Wil je meer informatie over de functie of Capgemini Invent en op een informele manier kennismaken met onze organisatie? Naast het bezoeken van een maandelijkse lunch, kun je je ook aanmelden voor een één op één koffie chat met een consultant uit het team waarin je geïnteresseerd bent. Heb je interesse in deze optie, neem dan per mail contact op met de recruiter onder deze vacature. Bij voldoende aansluiting, plannen we zo snel mogelijk een koffie chat in.

Werken bij Capgemini Invent

Baanbrekende veranderingen zijn niet nieuw. Wel nieuw is de snelheid waarmee deze veranderingen zich voordoen. Toonaangevende bedrijven gedragen zich als levende organismen en zorgen ervoor dat zij zich constant aanpassen aan verandering. Als Capgemini Invent helpen wij organisaties om te innoveren en transformeren door strategie, data science, technologie en design te combineren. We zijn een werkgever met oog voor jou en het vizier op de toekomst, waarin duurzaamheid, diversiteit en inclusie de hoofdrollen spelen.

Meer lezen over:

- Duurzaamheid

- Diversiteit en inclusie

- Werken bij Capgemini Invent

Om de veiligheid en integriteit binnen onze organisatie te borgen, maakt een backgroundcheck onderdeel uit van het onboardingsproces.

Neem contact op

Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met jouw recruiter.

Maryam el Allati

- Maryam-el.allati@capgemini.com

jobs.description:
About the job you’re considering

Capgemini’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is a dynamic part of our global cybersecurity consulting practice. With over 200 successful digital identity engagements in the past five years, we’re proud to be recognized as one of the world’s leading IAM strategic consulting, advisory, and delivery providers.

We take a business-first approach to digital identity and welcome professionals with a range of experiences - whether your strengths lie in business consulting, technology consulting, or a blend of both. Our diverse team works collaboratively to ensure IAM solutions are effective, inclusive, and tailored to our clients’ needs.

We cover all aspects of digital identity, including:

- Access Management

- Identity Governance and Administration

- Privileged Access Management

Our consulting is backed by world-class technology delivery and service operations from our global team. We remain proudly independent and invest heavily in training to ensure our consultants offer trusted, unbiased advice across established and emerging technologies. Joining Capgemini’s IAM team means working at the forefront of digital identity innovation.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

We work in all aspects of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including strategy, design and solution delivery for Enterprise, Customer and Privileged IAM.

Everyone in our IAM team contributes in one or more of the following areas:

- Understanding and defining IAM business requirements

- Designing and implementing IAM solutions, including technology and process improvements

- Advising clients on IAM strategy and transformation

- Contributing to or leading successful IAM projects

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

We value a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You may have practical experience in areas such as:

- IAM consultancy and advisory work, helping organizations improve digital identity practices

- Developing IAM Target Operating Models and effective processes

- Designing IAM solutions and architecture

- Delivering IAM solutions using technologies like Microsoft Azure, Ping Identity, Okta, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, BeyondTrust — or other modern IAM tools

- For delivery and architecture roles, we are particularly interested in candidates who hold hands-on practitioner or architect-level certifications in relevant IAM technologies. These certifications help demonstrate your depth of expertise and commitment to excellence in the field.

We understand IAM is a broad field, and we welcome candidates with transferable skills, whether your experience is more technical, business-focused, or based on less common IAM products.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2)  under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

- Declare they have a disability, and

- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain  Security Check (SC) clearance .

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

- You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

- To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

- You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

- You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. jobs.description:
Bij Capgemini Invent geloven we dat het maken van impact belangrijk is. Als strategie en transformatieconsultants combineren we onze strategische en creatieve capaciteiten en werken we nauw samen met klanten om baanbrekende oplossingen te leveren. Sluit je bij ons aan om transformaties te sturen die zijn afgestemd op de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Alles ondersteund door technologie die met een doel is gecreëerd.

- Uren: 32 to 40 uur per week

- Werkplek: Utrecht, bij de opdrachtgever op locatie en vanuit huis

- Ervaring: Medior management consultant

Jouw mogelijkheden als Management Consultant Cloud Strategy bij Capgemini Invent

Als Senior Consultant Cloud Strategy krijg je een sleutelrol in het begeleiden van onze opdrachtgevers naar de Cloud en het oplossen van hun grote Cloud vraagstukken. Hierbij geef je advies en werk je nauw samen met collega’s, met wie je kunt sparren en van wie je kunt leren. Samen navigeren jullie klanten naar de Cloud, waarbij je meewerkt aan de implementatie hiervan.

In het kort:

- Cloudadvies: Inspireer, leid en ondersteun organisaties bij het adopteren van Cloud om bedrijfs- en inkomstenmodellen te creëren, groei te genereren, te voldoen aan regelgeving en de ecologische voetafdruk te verkleinen.

- Strategische Cloudenablement: Ontwikkel en lever uitgebreide Cloudstrategieën die bedrijfs-, applicatie-, data-, beveiligings-, integratie- en platformaspecten omvatten om organisaties toekomstbestendig te maken.

- Oplossingen met bedrijfsfocus: Creëer en implementeer Cloudstrategieën die adoptie, versnelling en innovatie voor klanten stimuleren middels Cloud.

- Samenwerkende innovatie: Werk met en communiceer op alle organisatieniveaus om nieuwe bedrijfs- en operationele modellen te ontwerpen en te implementeren, gebruikmakend van markttrends en in te spelen op klantuitdagingen.

- Duurzame transformaties: Draag bij aan duurzame organisatorische transformaties door je steentje bij te dragen aan Cloud strategie en thought leadership.

- Cloud projecten leiden: Leid Cloud projecten en help de klant bij het vinden van oplossingen voor hun Cloud vraagstukken. Daarnaast ondersteun je junior Cloud consultants in hun Cloud ontwikkelingen.

Je thuisbasis bij Capgemini Invent

Jij vormt met circa 60 collega’s de unit Business Technology. Binnen het aandachtsgebied Tech driven transformation focus je op de optimale werking van IT-afdelingen binnen vooraanstaande (inter)nationale organisaties. Met de juiste digitale strategieën, operating modellen, AI oplossingen en innovatieve technologieën helpen we organisaties te vernieuwen en mee te bewegen met de digitale revolutie. We vormen een hecht team van professionals met oog voor elkaar én het beste resultaat. Met een goede balans tussen hard werken en onderlinge gezelligheid halen we het beste uit onszelf. Daarnaast profiteer je van alle kennis en behulpzame collega’s in het grote, internationale Capgemini-netwerk. Een netwerk met ongekende mogelijkheden: je kunt kennismaken met de werkzaamheden van andere teams en je ontwikkelen in de richting die jij wilt.

Benefits

- Direct een vast contract en een passend salaris inclusief bonusregeling.

- Een mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je kunt kiezen voor een leaseauto, NS businesscard of uitbetaling van je reisvergoeding.

- Get the future you want. Je krijgt alle mogelijkheden om zelf te pionieren en je loopbaan zelf vorm te geven. Wij bieden je de mogelijkheid om verschillende trainingen te volgen, passend bij jouw ambitie en groeipad;

- 26 vakantiedagen. Zin in extra vrije tijd? Koop dan dagen bij;

- Een pensioen waarvan het werkgeversaandeel volledig wordt betaald en de keuze om dat zelf aan te vullen;

- Werk flexibel in heel Nederland met onze connectiviteitsvergoeding;

- Thuiswerken? Dat kan! Hoewel je altijd welkom bent op kantoor, helpen we je ook graag met het inrichten van een fijne werkplek thuis;

- Capgemini Invent is wereldwijd actief, wat ervoor zorgt dat er mogelijkheden zijn om op termijn in het buitenland te werken;

- Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken;

Alles over werken bij Capgemini

Ook krijg je de mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan Capgemini Invent en aan je eigen persoonlijke groei. Hier kan je denken aan de volgende werkzaamheden:

- Business Development – Werk mee aan proposals, bids en het bouwen van proposities. Bouw hiermee je netwerk op en gebruik je eigen kennis en ervaring om proposities te bouwen.

- Interne bijdrage – Verbeter Capgemini Invent, denk mee over hoe wij onze bedrijfsvoering kunnen verbeteren of draag een steentje bij aan het trainen van onze mensen.

- Learning & Development – Volg trainingen die passen bij je carrièreontwikkeling en behaal relevante (Cloud) certificaten.

Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Naast je ambitie om een leidende rol in Cloud projecten op je te nemen, waarbij je meerdere werkstromen ontwerpt en leidt, neem je de verantwoordelijkheid voor elementen van de propositie. Je hebt affiniteit met verschillende projecten met een betekenisvolle impact, met het verbeteren van de bedrijfsvoering met technologie affiniteit en het ontwikkelen van Cloud strategieën.

Kun je er hier ook een of meer van afvinken? Dan ontmoeten we je graag!

- Ervaring met Cloud strategie en implementatie voor grote of middelgrote bedrijven, en de uitdagingen die daarbij komen kijken of as solution architecting experience.

- Ervaring met het bouwen en leveren van proposities.

- Een afgeronde wo-masteropleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT zoals Business & Information Management, Information Management, Innovation Management, Change Management, Bedrijfskunde of soortgelijke wo-masteropleidingen.

- Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring met consultancy op het gebied van IT en digitalisering in een businessomgeving.

- Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels. Dit is nodig vanwege de internationale omgeving waarin je werkt.

For this role it is a must to speak Dutch (at least B2 level) and live in The Netherlands.

jobs.title: Capgemini Invent - Senior Project Management Consultant
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI.

Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are excited to help organizations deliver complex business and technology transformations. You will join our Transformation Management capability, helping clients establish governance, drive execution discipline, manage delivery risk, and realize business value across large-scale transformation programs.

The Transformation Management capability focuses on program governance, PMO leadership, integrated planning, dependency management, value realization, and executive reporting. Our consultants help clients bring structure, transparency, and momentum to complex transformations while leveraging AI-enabled ways of working to improve decision-making and delivery outcomes.

Your Role

As a PMO Transformation Consultant, you will support complex transformation programs by applying structured program management practices, governance disciplines, and analytical problem-solving skills. You will work closely with client leaders, transformation offices, and delivery teams to drive execution and visibility across multiple workstreams.

You will:

- Support enterprise transformation programs through governance, coordination, and execution management

- Maintain integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities across workstreams

- Manage RAID logs and facilitate risk, issue, dependency, and decision management processes

- Develop executive-ready dashboards, status reports, and Steering Committee materials

- Support Transformation Management Office (TMO) and PMO functions, including governance and performance reporting

- Coordinate activities across business and technology teams to ensure alignment and accountability

- Analyze program performance metrics, delivery health indicators, and transformation outcomes

- Support value realization tracking, KPI monitoring, and benefits management initiatives

- Facilitate meetings, workshops, and governance forums while documenting actions and decisions.

- Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, analysis, and program coordination

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including familiarity with generative AI tools and an understanding of how AI can improve business and transformation outcomes. You are comfortable working in AI-augmented ways to enhance analysis, reporting, and collaboration while understanding responsible AI principles related to ethics, security, governance, and privacy.

Required Experience

- 2-5 years of consulting, PMO, TMO, program management, or transformation experience

- Experience supporting large-scale business or technology transformation initiatives

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

- Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint capabilities

- Experience preparing executive communications and leadership reporting

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Comfortable working across cross-functional teams and leadership groups

Preferred Experience

- Consulting experience within a professional services environment

- Experience supporting ERP, digital, operating model, or technology transformation programs

- Exposure to governance design, portfolio management, agile delivery, or value realization

- Familiarity with program and project management methodologies

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $76,000 - $115,500.

These may include, but are not limited to: Geographic location, Education and qualifications, Certifications and licenses, Relevant experience and skills, Seniority and performance, Market and business consideration, Internal pay equity.

It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws.

- Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave

jobs.description:

As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

frog is the customer experience and design practice of Capgemini Invent and the reinvention and experience partner for the eco-digital era. We work at the intersection of business strategy, experience design, and applied technology, bringing together strategists, designers, engineers, and data scientists. We start with the customer and carry our ideas through to production.

Within frog’s Customer Transformation practice, we help clients reinvent how they serve their customers. Our work combines business strategy, service and experience design, data, technology, and AI to transform contact centers and customer service operations. We help clients determine what to automate, what to augment, and how to improve customer outcomes while reducing cost to serve.

Your Role

As a Consultant or Senior Consultant, Service & Contact Center Transformation, you will lead or support workstreams focused on transforming how organizations serve their customers across voice, digital, and assisted channels. You will use quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify the drivers of customer demand, evaluate operational performance, and build the case for service transformation.

Working alongside practice leaders and multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute from current-state diagnostic and experience design through solution development, implementation, adoption, and value realization. You will collaborate with client stakeholders, designers, technology specialists, and operational leaders to develop practical recommendations that improve customer experience, frontline effectiveness, and contact center economics.

Key responsibilities include:

- Lead or support workstreams within contact center and customer service transformation engagements, from current-state assessment and discovery through solution design, production, adoption, and value realization.

- Conduct client and customer interviews, journey mapping, call-driver and intent analysis, operational benchmarking, and cost-to-serve modeling to identify the root causes of contact demand and performance challenges.

- Develop current-state assessments, journey maps, service blueprints, operating model options, transformation roadmaps, financial models, and business cases that translate analysis into clear recommendations.

- Support the design of AI-enabled service solutions incorporating voice AI agents, agent assist, next best action, intelligent routing, knowledge management, digital self-service, real-time monitoring, and effective human handoffs.

- Facilitate client workshops and working sessions, support proposals and oral presentations, contribute to change management and adoption, and help develop points of view, reusable assets, and junior team members.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

You are skilled at structuring complex business problems, finding insights in qualitative and quantitative data, and building a compelling case for change. You understand how service strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology come together to shape customer and frontline experiences.

You can engage in discussions about how telephony, routing, IVR, Contact Center as a Service, CRM, agent desktops, knowledge management, workforce management, quality management, and analytics operate as an integrated ecosystem. You bring deeper expertise in at least one area and have the curiosity and aptitude to build broader platform knowledge.

You understand the operational and financial measures that underpin service transformation, including containment, average handle time, first-contact resolution, transfer rate, customer satisfaction, and cost per contact. You can use these measures to establish performance baselines, evaluate opportunities, and support a credible business case.

Required Experience:

- Three or more years of relevant experience in management consulting, digital services, contact center operations, or customer service transformation. Candidates with five or more years of relevant experience may be considered for the Senior Consultant level.

- Functional depth in at least two areas such as customer service transformation, service experience design, contact forecasting and workforce management, quality management, IVR and routing design, conversational AI, speech analytics, performance measurement and KPIs, or omnichannel engagement.

- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience working with customer interaction data, call drivers, intent analysis, operational benchmarks, financial models, and contact center performance measures.

- Ability to collaborate across business strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology; facilitate client workshops; synthesize findings; and communicate clear recommendations to client and project stakeholders.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, with the ability to travel up to 50% on average based on project and client needs.

Preferred Experience:

- Experience combining business strategy with experience design, service design, conversation design, or user research, including exposure to both sales and service transformation.

- Exposure to Google’s contact center portfolio, including Customer Engagement Suite, CCAI Platform, Agent Assist, Conversational Agents, and Dialogflow CX, or emerging conversational AI platforms such as Sierra or Decagon.

- Familiarity with platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Five9, Verint, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, Agentforce Contact Center, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Cresta, or Observe.AI.

- Experience in telecommunications, insurance, or financial services, with an understanding of how regulatory requirements affect automation and customer interactions.

- A current Contact Center as a Service or conversational AI platform certification, a willingness to obtain relevant certification, or an advanced degree such as an MBA.

- Advise clients on supply chain technology and digital transformation opportunities, including SAP S/4HANA and leading planning platforms, while maintaining a business-first perspective.

- Contribute to business development, thought leadership, capability building, and go-to-market activities within the Supply Chain Transformation practice.

We are looking for high-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges and delivering tangible business impact. This opportunity is suitable for candidates from leading management consulting firms as well as industry professionals with strong supply chain transformation, advisory, or continuous improvement experience.

- 2–8 years of experience in management consulting, supply chain advisory, business transformation, or related industry roles.

- Experience across at least two areas of the supply chain, such as demand and supply planning, procurement, manufacturing, warehouse operations, logistics, or inventory management.

- Demonstrated experience supporting transformation initiatives, operating model design, process improvement, or large-scale change programs.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and develop practical, data-driven recommendations.

- Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.

Preferred:

- Prior experience in a recognised management consulting firm, supply chain boutique, or transformation advisory practice.

- Experience supporting SAP-enabled supply chain transformations or digital supply chain programs.

- Knowledge of Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), supply chain analytics, network optimization, or procurement transformation.

- Interest in applying AI and Generative AI to supply chain and operations challenges.

- Explore how emerging technologies, including AI and generative AI, can enable new customer experiences, products, services, and business models.

- Help translate strategic opportunities into product and experience directions by contributing to concepts, customer journeys, service blueprints, product requirements, prototypes, and other tangible expressions of strategy.

- Support financial modeling, revenue forecasting, opportunity assessment, and business-case development where appropriate.

- Collaborate with Designers, Technologists, Product Managers, Researchers, and other specialists from early opportunity definition and concept development through validation, launch, and scale.

- Facilitate collaboration and alignment with clients through stakeholder interviews, workshops, co-creation sessions, strategic discussions, working sessions, and presentations.

- Create clear, well-structured, and compelling strategic narratives, frameworks, recommendations, and deliverables that translate complex analysis into actionable direction.

- Use AI-augmented ways of working to strengthen research, accelerate analysis, explore alternatives, and improve the clarity and effectiveness of client deliverables.

- Contribute to business development efforts through research, opportunity framing, proposal development, and strategic recommendations.

You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

- One to five years of relevant experience across strategy consulting, corporate strategy and innovation, product management, product marketing, design research, investment banking, or a related field.

- Strong qualitative, quantitative, commercial, and analytical problem-solving capabilities.

- Ability to connect customer needs, market dynamics, emerging trends, and commercial considerations into a cohesive strategic point of view.

- Experience supporting business, product, experience, innovation, or growth strategy initiatives.

- Familiarity with qualitative and quantitative research methods, market analysis, competitive analysis, trend analysis, and opportunity assessment.

- Ability to use AI, generative AI, analytics, or other intelligence-enabled approaches to enhance research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, or solution development.

- Understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, may influence future products, experiences, services, and business models.

- Ability to evaluate the customer and commercial implications of strategic opportunities and recommendations.

- Strong written, verbal, visual, and presentation skills, with the ability to structure and communicate a compelling point of view on complex topics.

- Passion for collaborating with multidisciplinary teams of Designers, Technologists, Researchers, Product Managers, and other innovators.

- Confidence collaborating with and presenting to client stakeholders.

- Curiosity about new businesses, products, experiences, technologies, consumer behaviors, and cultural trends shaping the present and future.

- Ability to work effectively in a dynamic consulting environment while managing multiple priorities and contributing to high-quality client deliverables.

- A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is expected. An MBA or other advanced degree may be beneficial but is not required.

As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. About the Job You're Considering

At Capgemini Invent, our Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team makes AI work at scale by combining data science and engineering with business consulting. We build context-driven analytics and GenAI/agentic systems that reflect how decisions and work actually happen — grounded in semantic layers, strong data foundations, and governance embedded in decision flows. With a builder-advisor (“forward deployed”) mindset, DDT delivers production-ready impact across operations and customer domains, redefining what enterprise AI advisory looks like in practice.

Alongside our technical delivery teams, DDT's advisory practice ensures that AI and data transformation programs are governed, adopted, and sustained — turning technical delivery into measurable business outcomes.

Your Role

As a Senior Consultant, AI Transformation Advisory , you will lead critical components of AI, data, and enterprise transformation programs, helping clients translate AI strategy into measurable business outcomes. You will manage governance, operating model, adoption, value realization, and stakeholder engagement workstreams while serving as a trusted advisor to client managers and directors. You will also coach junior team members and coordinate cross-functional teams across business and technology functions.

Working closely with clients and delivery teams, you will help organizations establish scalable AI operating models, embed responsible AI practices, manage transformation risks, and drive sustainable adoption of AI and agentic AI capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Data Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Word de beste versie van jezelf als Senior Data Management Consultant

Bij Sogeti geloven we dat data de sleutel is tot succes. Ons team van gepassioneerde professionals werkt dagelijks aan baanbrekende oplossingen die bedrijven helpen om hun data optimaal te benutten. Wij helpen onze klanten om data om te zetten in bruikbare, AI-ondersteunde producten die gepersonaliseerde klantervaringen, bedrijfsinnovatie en het genereren van data-inkomsten stimuleren. Je krijgt de kans om te werken met de nieuwste technologieën en tools in een dynamische en collaboratieve omgeving. Onze klanten vertrouwen op ons om hen te begeleiden bij hun digitale transformatie en om hen te voorzien van inzichten die hun bedrijfsvoering verbeteren en direct bijdragen aan strategische en sociale doelstellingen.

Waarom jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Data Management Consultant speel je een cruciale rol in het professionaliseren van Data Governance bij onze klanten. Je adviseert organisaties over de inrichting en implementatie van governance-frameworks en zorgt ervoor dat verantwoordelijkheden rondom data helder worden belegd.

Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders vanuit zowel business als IT en helpt bij het definiëren van rollen zoals Data Owner en Data Steward. Je ontwikkelt en implementeert beleid, standaarden en processen voor onder andere datakwaliteit, metadata management, data lineage en data classificatie.

Daarnaast help je organisaties bij het opzetten en verbeteren van business glossaries en data catalogs en adviseer je over de inzet van Data Governance tooling, zoals Microsoft Purview en Collibra. Je weet complexe governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete en werkbare oplossingen en creëert draagvlak binnen verschillende lagen van de organisatie.

Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat Data Governance niet alleen op papier bestaat, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel wordt van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf

- Uitdagende IT-projecten bij grote organisaties door heel Nederland

- Een hechte community van Data-specialisten die je inspireren en verder brengen

- Persoonlijke begeleiding door een betrokken Career Manager

- Onbeperkt ontwikkelbudget voor professionele én persoonlijke groei

- Flexibel en hybride werken, met ruimte om je werk in te richten op een manier die bij jouw leven past

Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op

- Een vast contract van 32, 36 of 40 uur, met een beloningsbudget tot 7.101,67 bruto per maand, inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding

- Keuzevrijheid in mobiliteit: elektrische leaseauto, kilometervergoeding, NS‑Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan

- Een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike, omdat we een actieve en vitale leefstijl stimuleren

- 26 vakantiedagen met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C‑grade

- Toegang tot Benefits at Work, met kortingen op o.a. bol.com, HEMA, Wehkamp, elektronica, activiteiten en meer

- Een sterk inhouse L&D‑programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling centraal staat

- Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzame toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexibele regelingen

- Aandacht voor je (mentale) gezondheid met o.a. OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en korting op je sportabonnement

jobs.title: Capgemini Invent - Supply Chain Advisory - Senior Consultant - Auto
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

Within Intelligent Industry's Supply Chain Advisory practice, we help Automotive organizations transform supply chains into intelligent, resilient, and digitally enabled value networks. Our teams partner with OEMs, mobility providers, suppliers, and manufacturing organizations to redesign operating models, improve planning and execution capabilities, strengthen supply chain resilience, and unlock business value through analytics, AI, automation, and digital transformation.

We help clients address evolving challenges including supply chain disruption, supplier risk, inventory optimization, production volatility, electrification, battery ecosystems, and AI-enabled decision making across the end-to-end Automotive value chain.

Your Role

As an End-to-End Supply Chain Advisory practitioner, you will help Automotive clients improve performance across planning, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and fulfillment. You will work with client stakeholders and multidisciplinary consulting teams to solve complex supply chain challenges while designing future-ready operating models that improve agility, resilience, and business value.

Key responsibilities include:

- Support end-to-end supply chain transformation engagements spanning planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, inventory management, and fulfillment.

- Analyze supply chain performance and identify opportunities to improve cost, service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

- Assess supply chain operating models, organizational capabilities, and business processes to identify transformation opportunities.

- Develop business cases, transformation recommendations, future-state operating models, and implementation roadmaps.

- Help clients improve supply chain visibility, supplier collaboration, inventory management, and operational resilience.

- Apply analytics, AI, GenAI, and automation capabilities to improve forecasting, planning, decision making, and performance management.

- Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to align business priorities, transformation objectives, and value realization goals.

- Collaborate across planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and technology teams to support integrated supply chain initiatives.

- Develop executive-ready presentations, analyses, and recommendations that support strategic decision making.

- Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, capability development, and innovation initiatives across the Supply Chain Advisory practice.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience:

- 4-7 years of consulting and/or industry experience in supply chain, operations, manufacturing, procurement, logistics, or transformation-related roles.

- Experience supporting end-to-end supply chain transformation initiatives across multiple functional domains.

- Understanding of Automotive supply chain processes across planning, supplier management, procurement, manufacturing, inventory management, logistics, and fulfillment.

- Experience conducting business assessments, process analysis, operating model evaluations, or transformation diagnostics.

- Strong analytical, quantitative, and structured problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience developing business cases, transformation recommendations, and executive-level presentations.

- Ability to translate complex data and analysis into actionable business recommendations.

- Experience facilitating stakeholder meetings, workshops, and collaborative working sessions.

- Exposure to analytics, automation, AI, GenAI, or digital transformation initiatives within supply chain environments.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.

Preferred Experience:

- Experience supporting Automotive OEM, Tier 1, Tier 2, mobility, or industrial manufacturing organizations.

- Familiarity with production planning, supplier collaboration, inventory optimization, manufacturing operations, transportation, and distribution networks.

- Exposure to electrification, battery supply chains, connected manufacturing, or next-generation mobility ecosystems.

- Experience with digital supply chain platforms, control towers, planning solutions, or supply chain analytics tools.

- APICS/ASCM certification, Lean Six Sigma certification, MBA, or equivalent credentials.

jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
About the Job You’re Considering

The Strategy and Transformation consultant supports Capgemini clients to innovate and develop new strategies, services and products. He/she designs and implements new business and operating models and brings to life the organizations of the future. He/she develops customer insights, organizational knowledge and market perspectives.

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

The Workforce & Organization (W&O) is Capgemini Invent’s people‑led transformation capability, focused on helping organizations adapt their workforce, operating models, and ways of working to deliver sustainable business outcomes. W&O partners with clients to design and implement future‑ready organizations—aligning strategy, talent, culture, and technology to enable large‑scale transformation and improved workforce performance.

He or she is developing a specialization within a specific domain of expertise or industry. He or she is responsible for the completion of a part of a project or activities can lead a small team. He or she is client oriented and learns to explore sales activities.

- Design/facilitate workshops for leaders and impacted teams

- Strong collaboration across business and technology teams

- Coach junior team members and maintain quality standards

- 5–8 years OCM/transformation experience with client-facing leadership

- Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills

- Experience with shaping communications, training, and readiness activities at scale

- Clear, pragmatic communicator with strong delivery discipline

- Working understanding of how AI‑enabled tools and solutions are applied in organizational change contexts, including their role in shaping change approaches, supporting execution, and enabling adoption across the human change journey.

- Fluency with OCM frameworks and adoption measurement and agentic workflows
