jobs.title: Senior Consultant/Manager i CX Transformation-teamet i frog
jobs.description:
I frog, part of Capgemini Invent, tror vi at de beste virksomhetene skapes gjennom ekstraordinære opplevelser. Vi hjelper organisasjoner med å forstå mennesker bedre, tenke nytt om hvordan de skaper verdi, og bygge løsningene som trengs for å lykkes i en verden i stadig endring. Vi kombinerer strategi, design, teknologi, data og AI for å hjelpe virksomheter med å skape sømløse og meningsfulle opplevelser på tvers av digitale og fysiske kontaktpunkter. Sammen med kundene våre utvikler vi nye tjenester, kundeopplevelser, arbeidsmåter og kapabiliteter som skaper varig verdi.

Om rollen

Som Senior Consultant/Manager i CX Transformation vil du bidra til å forme fremtidens kundeopplevelser gjennom å utvikle strategier, designe nye opplevelser og realisere transformasjon i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, teknologi og forretning.

I denne rollen vil du:

- Lede eller bidra til transformasjonsprogrammer innen kundeopplevelse, markedsføring, salg og kundeservice.

- Utvikle kunde- og forretningsstrategier basert på innsikt, analyse og kundebehov.

- Designe fremtidige kunde- og medarbeiderreiser, prosesser og driftsmodeller.

- Hjelpe kunder med å ta i bruk ny teknologi, AI og data-drevne arbeidsmåter for å forbedre kundeopplevelser og operasjonell ytelse.

- Drive workshops, fasilitere beslutningsprosesser og samarbeide med ledere og fagspesialister på alle nivåer.

- Bidra til forretningsutvikling, tilbudsarbeid og videreutvikling av våre fagområder innen CX Transformation.

Din profil

- Du har 3+ års erfaring fra management consulting eller byrå, med prosjekter innenfor kundeopplevelse, markedsføring, salg og/eller kundeservice.

- Mastergrad med sterke akademiske resultater.

- Sterk strategisk og analytisk forståelse, med evne til å strukturere komplekse problemstillinger.

- Du trives med å jobbe i tverrfaglige team og evner å bygge tillit hos kunder og kolleger.

- Du har erfaring med å lede eller bidra til komplekse endrings- og transformasjonsinitiativ

- Du har sterke kommunikasjonsevner (på norsk og engelsk, minimum B2-nivå) og er komfortabel med fasilitering, presentasjoner og stakeholder management.

- Du har en forståelse for hvordan teknologi, data og KI påvirker CX. Erfaring med CRM/MarTech plattformer (Salesforce/Adobe) er en fordel.

Hvorfor vil du trives hos oss:
Hos oss er det rom for å skape din egen rolle og karriere. Initiativ, samarbeid og utvikling er nøkkelaspekter når vi beskriver vårt arbeidsmiljø. Det finnes uendelige muligheter for å akselerere din karriere og utvikling. Vi har et sterkt fokus på menneskene i selskapet og ønsker å sikre at våre konsulenter har de beste mulighetene til å prestere og utvikle seg selv.

- Spennende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i ett av verdens største konsulenthus. Du vil ha leveranseansvar, lede og/eller delta i tverrfaglige team for å skape varige resultater for våre kunder.

- Tverrfaglig ekspertise, der du får samarbeide med markedsledende kunder og et globalt nettverk av erfarne konsulenter med nødvendig kompetanse for å levere prosjekter ende-til-ende.

- Høyt fokus på profesjonell og personlig utvikling, inkludert mentorordning og personlig karriereplanlegging, sertifiseringer, faggrupper og kompetanseutvikling.

- Fleksibilitet for å sikre at våre ansatte kan balansere karriere med familie og individuelle behov.

- Et sterkt sosialt arbeidsmiljø med flere ulike sosiale eventer og aktiviteter tilpasset de fleste interesser gjennom året.

- Konkurransedyktige goder og fordeler, inkludert subsidiert treningsmedlemskap, treningsaktiviteter og attraktive firmahytter blant annet i Hemsedal, Trysil, Sirdal og Gaustablikk. Som en del av våre attraktive fordeler, tilbyr vi en ekstra ferieuke i tillegg til ordinær ferie til kandidater som ansettes som Manager eller i høyere stillinger.

Interessert?

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad snarest. Søknader behandles fortløpende, og vi ber kandidater inkludere CV og søknadsbrev.

Hvis du har spørsmål om stillingen kan du ta kontakt med:
Camille Juguet, head of CX Transformation, camille.juguet@capgemini.com.

Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.

Om frog

frog er en integrert del av Capgemini Invent, Capgemini-gruppens enhet og merkevare for strategi, transformasjon og innovasjon. I frog utvikler vi nye produkter, tjenester, merkevarer og kundeopplevelser. Hos oss jobber designere, strateger, teknologer, markedsførere og dataeksperter tett sammen for å utvikle løsninger som både engasjerer og skaper målbar effekt. I Norge består frog av rundt 80 medarbeidere i Oslo, Bergen og Stavanger. Vi er en del av et internasjonalt fagmiljø med over 2 000 spesialister i frog over hele verden, og samarbeider tett med resten av Capgemini både lokalt og globalt. Du kan se noen eksempler på hva vi jobber med, og hvem vi er på www.frog.co .

Om Capgemini
Capgemini er en AI-drevet global partner for forretnings- og teknologitransformasjon som leverer konkret forretningsverdi. Vi former organisasjoners fremtid og gjør den til virkelighet ved hjelp av KI, teknologi og mennesker. Med en nesten 60 år lang historie er vi en ansvarlig og mangfoldig gruppe med over 420 000 ansatte i mer enn 50 land. Gjennom vår ekspertise innen strategi, ingeniørfag, design, ingeniørtjenester og forretningsvirksomhet leverer vi omfattende tjenester og løsninger basert på dyp bransjekunnskap og et bredt partnernettverk. Konsernet rapporterte globale inntekter på 22,5 milliarder euro for 2025.
Make it real | www.capgemini.no

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

• Proven ability to lead complex workstreams.
• Experience supporting AI and agentic AI initiatives, including governance, adoption, and business readiness.

jobs.title: Sr. Consultant - Life Sciences Omnichannel Strategy & Customer Transformation
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
Your Role

As a Senior Consultant (SC) on Capgemini Invent’s Life Sciences team, you will play a key client-facing role, managing on-site relationships, leading project workstreams, and supporting practice development through sales, recruitment, training, and team engagement. This position offers exposure to diverse projects, building both depth and breadth of experience.

Project Delivery:

- Lead workstreams in Life Sciences commercial and customer transformation programs.

- Drive pharma marketing strategy, sales effectiveness, and brand planning initiatives.

- Develop business strategies for commercial organizations, including customer segmentation and engagement models.

- Design and facilitate client workshops on commercial vision, customer journey, and omnichannel strategy.

- Advise client marketing, sales, and commercial leaders on structured problem solving and strategy.

- Shape CRM and omnichannel strategies in partnership with Salesforce teams.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality workstream delivery.

- Lead analyses to assess commercial performance and identify transformation opportunities.

- Synthesize insights into executive-ready recommendations and roadmaps.

- Support development of AI-enabled commercial and CRM use cases focused on business value.

- Contribute to CRM capability maturity assessments and identify improvement areas.

- Translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories.

- Play a key role in client proposals and RFI/RFP responses.

- Identify new business and project expansion opportunities.

- Support recruiting, training, and mentoring within the Life Sciences team.

Qualifications & Experience

- 5+ years advising or working with Pharma/Life Sciences commercial teams on customer journey, omnichannel strategy, and CRM execution

- Deep knowledge of omnichannel engagement, including journeys, segmentation, targeting, digital marketing, CRM, and content personalization

- CRM platform experience (e.g., Salesforce Health/Marketing/Sales Cloud) in business/advisory roles; hands-on configuration a plus

- Led workstreams and managed cross-functional teams of analysts and tech specialists

- Strong consulting skills: client problem-solving, workshop facilitation, executive storytelling, deck building, and client interviews

- Excellent analytical and quantitative skills for structuring and interpreting business analyses (not coding-heavy)

- Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, focused on storytelling and analytical modeling

- Confident professional presence with senior and executive client engagement skills

- Self-motivated, proactive, and effective in ambiguous consulting settings

- Willing to travel up to 80% as needed

- Bachelor's degree required

- Must be legally authorized to work in the US without sponsorship

What You'll Love Working Here

At Capgemini Invent, we empower our people to explore, innovate, and progress. As a global community of entrepreneurial thinkers, you’ll be encouraged to step up, try new things, and make a mark. As part of Capgemini Invent, you’ll have the flexibility to work your own way and find your balance. We give you the ownership and support you need to grow your skills and shape your future path.

Hybrid working

We believe that flexibility is the key to a healthy work-life balance. That’s why our employees work with their managers to determine an arrangement that works best for their role and personal circumstances.

Flex abroad

Capgemini’s Flex Abroad program gives employees the opportunity to work abroad for up to 45 days in a 12-month period. This allows you to temporarily change your working environment while staying connected to your team and career goals.

jobs.title: Capgemini Invent - Program & Change Acceleration Managing Consultant
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
About the Job You’re Considering

The Strategy and Transformation consultant supports Capgemini clients to innovate and develop new strategies, services and products. He/she designs and implements new business and operating models and brings to life the organizations of the future. He/she develops customer insights, organizational knowledge and market perspectives.

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

The Workforce & Organization (W&O) is Capgemini Invent’s people‑led transformation capability, focused on helping organizations adapt their workforce, operating models, and ways of working to deliver sustainable business outcomes. W&O partners with clients to design and implement future‑ready organizations—aligning strategy, talent, culture, and technology to enable large‑scale transformation and improved workforce performance.

Your Role

Heorshe is responsible for the completion of a small or medium sized project can lead a team. Heorshe develops a reputation for its specific domain expertise internally and stats to develop market visibility. Heorshe is involved in training delivery to share knowledge in the organization.

As a managing consultant you’ll own change programs within large transformations: driving leadership alignment, adoption strategy, and measurable outcomes, while supporting growth through solution shaping and people leadership.

You’ll lead organizational change strategy transformations, which can include a wide range of programs such as leadership and culture changes, technology transformations, establishing and delivering organizational change adoption initiatives and/or driving AI adoption and other workforce transformation.  This helps leaders to align on purpose, culture, and workforce capabilities. This work sits at the intersection of strategy, people, technology and performance. You will also be responsible for building trusted advisor partnerships with senior client stakeholders and contribute to the continued growth of this exciting practice.

You will:

- Lead enterprise‑scale change programs and integrated adoption strategies across complex transformation workstreams

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, shaping organizational change strategy, governance, and leadership routines to sustain momentum

- Drive executive alignment across complex stakeholder ecosystems; build leadership narratives and executive‑ready recommendations

- Oversee change execution at scale, including communications, training, readiness, and human‑AI change adoption deliverables (e.g., stakeholder maps, impact assessments, RACI, governance)

- Lead high‑performing teams, coach and develop talent, ensure delivery excellence, and support business development through proposals and client relationship growth

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

- 8–10+ years of change and transformation leadership experience, with a strong track record running large, complex programs and engaging senior stakeholders

- Proven ability to shape change strategies, organizational change management (OCM) frameworks, and enterprise adoption plans tied to business outcomes

- Experience measuring adoption and value realization, including adoption measurement, KPIs, and agentic workflows

- Ability to lead teams and drive results in ambiguity, including coaching teams on applying AI‑enabled tools across the evolving workforce

- Strong commercial mindset with experience supporting shaping, sales, and client advisory conversations

jobs.title: Management Consultant, Data & AI (Manager/Senior Manager)
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Som en del av vårt Data & AI-team hjälper du våra kunder att bli mer datadrivna och att skapa affärsvärde genom data, analys och AI. Du stöttar organisationer i att utveckla de strategier, styrningsmodeller, arbetssätt och tekniska förmågor som krävs för att lyckas med sin data- och AI-transformation – från strategi och utforskande till implementering och skalning. Vi söker flera senioritetsnivåer, från  Manager  till  Senior Manager . Vilken nivå som erbjuds kommer att baseras på kandidatens erfarenhet, kompetens och tidigare meriter.

Hos oss kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att:

- Hjälpa våra kunder att förstå vilken påverkan data och AI har på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå samt omsätta insikter till konkreta affärsresultat.

- Utforma och utveckla data- och AI-strategier, styrningsmodeller (Governance) och initiativ för att stärka datadriven kultur och beslutsfattande.

- Stödja kunder i att använda och styra sina datatillgångar för att uppnå strategiska mål och skapa ökat affärsvärde.

- Leda eller bidra till utvecklingen av moderna dataplattformar och analysförmågor som möjliggör tillgång till tillförlitlig data av hög kvalitet.

- Rådgiva kunder kring AI-adoption, AI-drivna innovationer och utveckling av användningsfall som skapar mätbara effekter.

- Arbeta med innovativa frågeställningar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, strategi, data och AI.

- Leda eller bidra till transformationsprogram inom data, analys, AI, process mining och intelligent automation.

- Bygga starka relationer med kunder och intressenter samt, beroende på senioritetsnivå, bidra till affärsutveckling, försäljningsinitiativ och anbudsarbete.

- Coacha och utveckla teammedlemmar samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveranser och projekt.

Din profil

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av, eller ett starkt intresse för, ett eller flera områden inom data och AI, kombinerat med erfarenhet av data- och analysdriven transformation. Du har exempelvis arbetat med data- och AI-strategi, governance eller moderna dataplattformar och dataarkitekturer, såsom Snowflake eller Databricks. Du är van att omsätta data till verksamhetsnytta genom analytics, datavisualisering och beslutsstöd, och har gärna erfarenhet av process mining eller intelligent automation.

Vi ser också gärna att du har kunskap inom AI-adoption, utveckling och skalning av AI-use cases samt AI-arkitektur och större AI-transformationer på företagsnivå. Erfarenhet av data- och AI-regelefterlevnad är meriterande, liksom ett intresse för nya teknologier och arbetssätt inom området, exempelvis agentbaserad AI (Agentic AI). Som person drivs du av att skapa värde genom data och AI och trivs i en miljö där innovation kombineras med affärsfokus.

Vi ser även att du har:

- Erfarenhet från management consulting eller liknande rådgivande roller.

- Stark kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att samarbeta med och hantera intressenter på olika nivåer i en organisation.

- Förmåga att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta data- och analyslösningar och fungera som bryggan mellan verksamhet och teknik.

- Erfarenhet av att leda initiativ, projekt eller team.

- Erfarenhet av affärsutveckling, kundbearbetning och anbudsarbete.

- Masterexamen med inriktning mot ekonomi, teknik, IT eller Data & Analytics.

- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska samt giltigt arbetstillstånd i Sverige.

Det här får du hos oss

- Meningsfull påverkan  Hjälp organisationer att frigöra värdet i sina data och AI-satsningar för att stärka konkurrenskraft, effektivitet och långsiktigt affärsvärde.

- Innovation i framkant  Arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan verksamhet, strategi, data och AI med de senaste metoderna, teknologierna och arbetssätten.

- Karriärutveckling  Utveckla din kompetens genom utbildningar, certifieringar, mentorskap och spännande uppdrag hos ledande organisationer.

- Samarbete och kunskapsdelning  Bli en del av ett inkluderande team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och entreprenörsanda står i fokus.

Bra att veta

Placering: För denna roll utgår du från vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm eller Göteborg och är redo att resa till kund vid behov. Senioritet och titel fastställs baserat på din bakgrund och erfarenhet.  Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomförs identitetskontroll via ID‑handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Make it real |  www.capgemini.com

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
About the Job You’re Considering

The Strategy and Transformation consultant supports Capgemini clients to innovate and develop new strategies, services and products. He/she designs and implements new business and operating models and brings to life the organizations of the future. He/she develops customer insights, organizational knowledge and market perspectives.

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

You’ll join the Business Technology (BT) team, whose mission is to align directly with the CIO agenda and help organizations shape large-scale technology transformations. BT focuses on strategy-led work supporting clients as they make major enterprise technology investments and define multi-year transformation roadmaps.

The work is centered on platform strategy, IT and AI operating models, and enterprise transformation-projects that are often board-facing, business-critical, and require strong integration between business strategy and technology decisions. BT is actively growing its capabilities in cloud strategy, AI architecture, and CIO advisory, with an emphasis on innovation, AI enablement, and modern operating models.

Your Role

He or she is developing a specialization within a specific domain of expertise or industry. He or she is responsible for the completion of a part of a project or activities can lead a small team. He or she is client oriented and learns to explore sales activities.

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead workstreams that help clients modernize enterprise technology platforms and operating models, with a strong focus on AI‑enabled transformation. You will partner closely with senior technology leaders to shape pragmatic, value‑driven strategies that embed AI into core platforms, translating complex architectural considerations into actionable roadmaps and delivery plans. In this role, you will take ownership of key client deliverables, contribute to team leadership and mentoring, and drive execution excellence across engagements.

In this role you will:

- Lead workstreams across platform strategy, IT strategy, and operating model design

- Facilitate workshops with CIO/CTO/CISO leaders to drive alignment and decisions

- Build board-ready roadmaps and investment cases tied to outcomes and value

- Integrate AI enablement into platform and operating model strategies

- Translate architecture constraints into practical sequencing and delivery approaches

- Coach junior team members and ensure quality under tight timelines

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

- 5–8 years in technology strategy, architecture, or management consulting

- Strong foundation in platform strategy/enterprise architecture and transformation roadmaps

- Working knowledge of cloud strategy and operating model implications

- AI landscape fluency; able to design practical enablement approaches and guardrails

- Executive-ready communication and strong client presence

- Comfortable owning workstreams and leading teams in complex environments

We are looking for a leader with a strong consulting track record in selling and delivering supply chain and operations transformations for industry leaders.  They will have experience in using technology to find innovative solutions to the issues faced in one or more of Consumer Products, Retail, Manufacturing (including Automotive), Life Sciences, Aerospace & Defence and Energy Utilities industry sectors. In particular they will understand the key supply chain challenges including globalisation, product, process and asset digitisation and supply chain and operations optimisation. They will have the deep experience of the transformation programme lifecycle from strategy through to implementation. No matter the project or customer, your work will have a meaningful impact on society, businesses and lives. It’s really rewarding. And it’s also really varied. You’ll potentially work on a huge variety of projects (some larger than others), so you could gain lots of experience in a short amount of time.

Why this role?

- Business development – using a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network to generate revenue.

- Engaging with Clients – developing relationships with senior members of the Tier 1 Client organizations.

- Developing propositions in supply chain strategy, manufacturing digitalisation, consulting and technology and ensuring these are relevant and timely.

jobs.title: Azure AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort genom Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Som Azure AI Transformation Lead leder du AI-transformation i kunduppdrag och hjälper våra kunder att gå från ambition till konkreta lösningar och värdeskapande, med Microsoft Azure som huvudsaklig teknisk plattform.

Du får även möjlighet att bidra till vår egen AI-transformation och utvecklingen av våra erbjudanden på Capgemini. Vi söker dig som kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens inom cloud och modern AI-utveckling med strategisk höjd. Du har en stark bakgrund inom Azure eller någon av de andra stora cloudplattformarna, och ett tydligt intresse för att arbeta med och vidareutveckla AI-lösningar inom Microsoft Azure.

Vi tror att du är en senior konsult eller arkitekt som har vuxit in i ett bredare transformationsansvar. Du kan diskutera affärsstrategi och arkitekturval, leda workshops med beslutsfattare och arbeta nära utvecklingsteam för att omsätta kundbehov till konkreta lösningar och affärsvärde.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i att:

- Leda och driva kunders AI-transformation från nulägesanalys till genomförande och värdeskapande.

- Identifiera kundens mognad, behov och prioriteringar inom AI samt omsätta detta i tydliga roadmapar och initiativ.

- Säkerställa rätt frågeställningar, arbetssätt, governance, säkerhet och kontroller för ett framgångsrikt AI-införande.

- Agera trusted advisor till beslutsfattare och stötta både strategiska initiativ, workshops och pre-sales-dialoger.

- Hantera komplexiteten i AI-införande genom att skapa struktur, framdrift och samverkan mellan verksamhet, teknik och förändringsledning.

- Leda arkitektur och teknisk lösningsdesign för AI- och Agentic AI-lösningar, med Microsoft Azure som huvudsaklig teknisk plattform.

- Bidra till att utveckla Capgeminis erbjudanden, tekniska förmågor och kundlösningar inom Azure AI, Generative AI och Agentic AI.

Din profil

- Djup teknisk kompetens inom cloud och erfarenhet av att arkitektera skalbara och säkra cloudlösningar på Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP eller motsvarande plattform.

- Praktisk erfarenhet av modern AI-utveckling på Azure eller motsvarande cloudplattform, exempelvis Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio och Microsoft Agent Framework, samt erfarenhet av AI-agenter och agentorkestrering.

- Bakgrund inom Software Engineering eller Data Engineering samt förmåga att förstå och utmana lösningar på arkitektur- och implementationsnivå.

- Flerårig erfarenhet av att driva transformation inom AI, Azure Cloud, data eller digitalisering, gärna som konsult.

- Förmåga att förena tekniskt djup med strategisk rådgivning och omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta lösningar och planer.

- Erfarenhet av arkitektur, governance, säkerhet och riskhantering i komplexa IT- och AI-miljöer.

- Erfarenhet av kunddialoger, workshops och lösningsutformning, samt pre-sales eller affärsutveckling.

- Stark kommunikativ förmåga och vana att facilitera dialoger med ledningsgrupper, verksamhet och tekniska team.

- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

- Möjligheten att ta en verklig nyckelroll i ett område där efterfrågan är hög och där du kan påverka både kunders och vår egen utveckling framåt.

- Ett konsultuppdrag på riktigt – där du får rådgiva, skapa riktning, bygga förtroende och leverera konkret affärsvärde.

- Tillgång till ett starkt nätverk av experter inom AI, Cloud, data, säkerhet och transformation – i Sverige, Norden och globalt.

- En miljö som uppmuntrar kunskapsdelning, innovation och ständig utveckling, där du får utrymme att forma erbjudanden och arbetssätt.

- Flexibla arbetssätt, stark gemenskap och goda möjligheter att utvecklas genom certifieringar, initiativ och spännande kunduppdrag.

Ansökan

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en global partner för affärs- och verksamhetstransformation i en tid präglad av AI. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att skapa en intelligent och hållbar framtid genom att kombinera AI, teknik och mänsklig expertis. Tillsammans hjälper vi verksamheter att utveckla sina arbetssätt, stärka innovationsförmågan och skapa tillväxt. Genom helhetslösningar som omfattar strategi, teknik, engineering och intelligent operations kombinerar vi djup branschkunskap med marknadsledande expertis inom AI, moln och data. Det gör det möjligt för våra kunder att omsätta ambitioner till mätbara affärsresultat i stor skala.

Med stöd av ett starkt partnernätverk och nära 60 års erfarenhet är Capgemini en ansvarstagande global organisation präglad av mångfald, med över 410 000 medarbetare i fler än 50 länder. Koncernens omsättning uppgick till 22,5 miljarder euro under 2025.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant Strategic Innovation & Transformation (frog)
jobs.description:
Intro

Impact maken op organisaties en hen helpen met nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Jij laat groeiambities uitkomen.

- Uren: 40

- Werkplek: Utrecht, bij de klant en remote

- Ervaring: medior/senior

Jouw mogelijkheden als Senior Consultant Strategic Innovation & Transformation bij Capgemini Invent

Wanneer grote bedrijven en publieke instellingen een visie voor de organisatie ontwikkelen, nieuwe businessmodellen ontwerpen of een digitale of duurzaamheidsstrategie voor de toekomst ontwikkelen, haak jij aan als senior consultant. Jij zorgt namens het Strategic Innovation & Transformation-team van het creatieve adviesbureau frog – part of Capgemini Invent dat organisaties groeiambities waarmaken.

In het kort:

- Je helpt grote organisaties bij ontwikkelingen die zij soms zelf niet eens zien aankomen. Je analyseert de uitdagingen en kansen van jouw klanten en biedt creatieve oplossingen, onder meer door te helpen bij visie, strategie, transformatieplannen en innovatie.

- Je groeit verder in je consultancyrol door je te specialiseren in een van onze focus-vakgebieden (New Venture Design, Innovation management of Strategy Enablement) of op een specifieke marktsector, in te spelen op nieuwe ontwikkelingen, kennis te delen en meer commerciële verantwoordelijkheden op je te nemen.

- Je coacht beginnende consultants.

Je thuisbasis bij Capgemini Invent

Impact maken. Dat doen we bij team Strategic Innovation & Transformation. Binnen een van de drie teams van frog - part of Capgemini Invent helpen we grote organisaties in Retail & Consumer Products, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services en in het Publieke domein op een creatieve manier met strategische vraagstukken, het accelereren van innovatie en het ontwikkelen van de ecosystemen en businessmodellen van de toekomst. Afhankelijk van jouw opdrachtgever werk je op locatie, vanuit huis of op kantoor in Utrecht. Met ongeveer dertig collega’s met verschillende expertises, ervaring en achtergronden vormen we één team. We helpen elkaar en maken samen impact. Wil je meer weten over frog en het type werk dat jouw team doet? Lees er alles over op de frog-website. Werken bij frog - part of Capgemini Invent betekent ook werken in het internationale hart van de innovatie. De eredivisie van de technologie. Een werkgever met oog voor jou en het vizier op de toekomst.

Benefits

- Direct een vast contract en een passend salaris.

- Volop mogelijkheden voor het volgen van trainingen en opleidingen passend bij jouw rol en gericht op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

- 26 vakantiedagen. Zin in extra veel vrije tijd? Koop dan dagen bij.

- Een pensioen waarvan het werkgeversaandeel volledig wordt betaald en de keuze om dat zelf aan te vullen, zodat je ook op je oude dag nog met plezier aan Capgemini Invent terugdenkt.

- Werken waar je maar wilt met onze connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

- Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken.

- Een leaseauto, NS-businesscard of uitbetaling van je reiskostenvergoeding.

​​​​​​​ Waarom deze vacature bij jou past

Nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerken met klanten en collega’s en aantoonbare resultaten halen, dat drijft jou. Je kunt goed analyseren en komt snel tot de kern van een probleem. En je zet strategie om naar de dagelijkse praktijk. Daarnaast deel je graag je kennis en kun je een klein team of projectgroep aansturen. Je bouwt een eigen (intern) netwerk op en ziet intern en extern commerciële kansen.

Kun je er hier ook een of meer van afvinken? Dan ontmoeten we je graag!

​​​​​​​

- Je hebt een wo-masteropleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur in een strategische, business-, industrial design of innovatieve richting.

- Je hebt minimaal drie jaar ervaring als consultant met verandertrajecten, digitale transformaties, strategie, innovatie en/of businessmodellen.

- Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.

- For this role it is a must to speak Dutch (at least B2 level) and live in The Netherlands.

- Heb je nog niet alle gevraagde ervaring, maar denk je dat deze baan wel goed bij je past? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact.

​​​​​​​Werken bij Capgemini Invent

Baanbrekende veranderingen zijn niet nieuw. Wel nieuw is de snelheid waarmee deze veranderingen zich voordoen. Toonaangevende bedrijven gedragen zich als levende organismen en zorgen ervoor dat zij zich constant aanpassen aan verandering. Als Capgemini Invent helpen wij organisaties om te innoveren en transformeren door strategie, data science, technologie en design te combineren. We zijn een werkgever met oog voor jou en het vizier op de toekomst, waarin duurzaamheid, diversiteit en inclusie de hoofdrollen spelen.

Meer lezen over:

- Duurzaamheid

- Diversiteit en inclusie

- Werken bij Capgemini Invent

jobs.title: ABAP Consultant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Capgemini is seeking a Senior SAP ABAP Developer with 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP custom development, technical design, integrations, enhancements, and production support. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in ABAP development across SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments and be capable of delivering complex technical solutions while mentoring junior team members.

This role requires strong analytical skills, end-to-end ownership of development activities, and the ability to work closely with functional consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to design, build, and support enterprise SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of complex SAP custom solutions.

- Develop and maintain RICEF objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) .

- Translate Functional Specifications (FS) into Technical Specifications (TS) and provide solution recommendations.

- Design and develop integration solutions using BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, Web Services, and APIs .

- Implement enhancements using BAdIs, User Exits, Enhancement Framework, Enhancement Spots, and Function Modules .

- Develop and optimize Object-Oriented ABAP (OO ABAP) applications.

- Create and maintain complex Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, and SAP Scripts .

- Develop advanced ALV reporting solutions and custom analytical reports.

- Perform code reviews and enforce development standards and best practices.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues through advanced debugging and root cause analysis.

- Support SAP upgrade, migration, and S/4HANA transformation projects.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams during project delivery, testing, cutover, and hypercare phases.

- Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.

- Ensure compliance with security, quality, and change management procedures.

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of SAP ABAP development experience.

- Strong expertise in Object-Oriented ABAP (OO ABAP) .

- Extensive experience developing:

- Reports

- Interfaces

- Conversions

- Enhancements

- Forms (RICEF)

- Advanced knowledge of:

- BAPIs

- RFCs

- IDocs

- BDCs

- Function Modules

jobs.title: Senior MES Consultant Siemens Opcenter
jobs.description:
Capgemini Engineering

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to to solutions against wildfires, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

What you’ll be working on as a Senior MES Consultant

As a senior MES Engineer specializing in Siemens Opcenter Execution at Capgemini, you will work on transforming production environments into smart factories. Being highly rewarding work, you will have to chance to:

- Make career impact: Work on Large scale MES Core Model Roll out & Traceability Upgrades in international leading companies in Pharma and F&B.

- Innovate highly regulated industries: Drive digital transformation in pharma projects, moving from paper to Electronic Batch Record (eBR) & MES Modernization for production to advance speed, quality, and compliance demands of modern Life Sciences manufacturing.

- Make sustainability real: Launch new sustainable product lines in the chemical industry with modern MES to support batch production, compliance, and end to end data capturing — from raw materials to finished goods.

Your responsibilities will include:

- You will typically support the automation team in the design and integration of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that enable real-time data processing, automation, and operational excellence.

- Designing interfaces between MES and ERP systems to improve data flow and operational coordination.

- Ensure compliance with best practices for MES development and integration, to meet project and industry requirements.

- Developing manufacturing recipes following ISA95 standards to ensure seamless and efficient operations.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate project requirements and develop IT documentation for MES systems.

Your profile

You are thriving in dynamic engineering environments and are naturally curious about automation in (highly regulated) industries. Ideally, you possess a proactive, result-driven mindset and demonstrates resilience under pressure, especially during the critical phases of complex manufacturing projects.

To excel in this role, you should have:

- Proven hands-on experience in MES, Historian systems, and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM).

- A strong understanding of batch processes and data integration.

- Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution modeling is essential, experience in the pharmaceutical industry is an asset.

- Strong communication skills with excellent teamwork abilities to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders and understand client needs.

- The capability to guide and mentor the technical team in design, coding, integration, configuration, deployment, and best practices.

* These criteria provide an indication of the profile we are looking for. If you do not meet every criterion but believe this role is a great fit for you, we warmly encourage you to apply or get in touch with us.

** Due to client screening requirements, this vacancy is applicable for EU passport holders only.

What we offer

- A gross salary between €4.500 and €5.600 per month, plus a mobility allowance of €850 and 8% holiday allowance (based on a 40-hour workweek).

- 26 vacation days. Looking for even more time off? You can purchase additional leave days.

- Engagement in projects that directly impact industrial technology and innovation, where you can collaborate with top engineers and expand your expertise.

- Access to career development programs, certifications, and digital learning platforms to support your growth.

- Contributions to your pension, and you also have the flexibility to make additional personal contributions.

- Work from wherever suits you best with our connectivity and home office allowance.

- A high-performance laptop and a SIM card that you may also use for personal purposes.

- FlexAbroad: Work up to 45 days per year from abroad.

- A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.

Your work environment

With over 200 colleagues, our Manufacturing & Industrial Operations department offers significant and meaningful contributions to various organisations in The Netherlands and occasionally abroad. Our people have expertise in offering partnerships and solutions around industrial automation, smart factory, and data science. Our projects vary tremendously, from upgrading automation systems for a vaccin production line, designing smart sensors based on IoT and cloud technology to reduce food waste, to developing predictive models to optimize warehouse logistics. And sometimes you are working as technical coordinator in large project teams of over 50 colleagues, and at other times you are working on a solution with only two or three other colleagues. This makes our work highly unpredictable in scope, project duration and commuting time. Yet also incredibly rewarding in terms of learning and growth opportunities. And the best thing is, everyone has your back in becoming successful. Because our clients, our partners, depend on it!

Curious about the culture, way of working, and career opportunities at Capgemini? Join one of our events to meet our colleagues, hear their personal stories, and get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at life at Capgemini. Visit our  events page  to explore upcoming events at our Utrecht Leidsche Rijn or Eindhoven office.

jobs.title: Medior Test Automation Consultant

Wil jij organisaties helpen om software met vertrouwen live te brengen? Jij bent iemand die verder kijkt dan alleen tooling. Je wilt jezelf ontwikkelen, zowel als consultant als inhoudelijk.

Make it Real

Bij Capgemini werk je niet alleen aan technologie, maar aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Voor klanten, voor de maatschappij en voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling. Je krijgt het vertrouwen om initiatief te nemen, jezelf te blijven uitdagen en impact te maken. Make it Real.

jobs.title: APS Consultant - IPC

Ervaring: Young Professional / Medior / Senior

Jouw mogelijkheden als Advanced Planning and Schedulling Consultant bij Capgemini

Heb jij een passie voor het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken en ben je klaar om jouw carrière een vliegende start te geven? Get the future you want

Die belofte doen wij aan jou. Dat begint al op dag één. Met een goede onboarding en gestructureerde en transparante groeipaden. Maar ook: volop mogelijkheden om daarvan af te wijken, zelf te pionieren en je eigen weg te kiezen. Daarbij kun je van onze kant rekenen op grenzeloos vertrouwen én collegiale support.

Als consultant werk je bij verschillende klanten, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je thuisbasis is onze Testing practice. jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering

At Capgemini Invent, our Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team makes AI work at scale by combining data science and engineering with business consulting. We build context-driven analytics and GenAI/agentic systems that reflect how decisions and work actually happen—grounded in semantic layers, strong data foundations, and governance embedded in decision flows. With a builder-advisor (“forward deployed”) mindset, DDT delivers production-ready impact across operations and customer domains, redefining what enterprise AI advisory looks like in practice.

Your Role

As a Senior Life Sciences AI Consultant, you will lead domain-specific workstreams within AI engagements, owning delivery from discovery through use case definition, requirements, and validation planning. You will serve as the primary life sciences domain voice on the team—partnering closely with scientific, quality, and operational stakeholders while translating complex regulatory and business needs into actionable AI solutions. In this role, you will build strong client relationships, drive structured problem-solving, and contribute to both client delivery and broader practice development.

- Own end-to-end domain workstreams across AI engagements, including discovery, use case definition, and solution shaping

- Lead and contribute to validation planning, including IQ/OQ/PQ approaches, CSV frameworks, and risk assessments for AI solutions in regulated environments

You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. - Experience working with or within quality, regulatory, manufacturing, or medical affairs

- Expérience dans un environnement de conseil en ingénierie et/ou chez un constructeur aéronautique (OEM) fortement souhaitée.

- Excellentes compétences de communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais.

- Solides compétences organisationnelles, avec une grande attention aux détails et la capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément.

- Minimum 7 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de l’ingénierie.

- Expérience en gestion de projets dans l’industrie aéronautique.

Autres informations

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
English follows Japanese

職務内容

募集 背景

近年、多くの企業でデータ活用の高度化や生成AIをはじめとするAI Transformationへの取り組みが加速しています。一方で、「データの分散」「品質のばらつき」「ガバナンスの不在」といった課題により、データドリブン経営やAI活用の実現を阻まれているケースも少なくありません。当社では、グローバルで培ってきた豊富な知見と実績を活かし、大手企業に対してデータ戦略策定、データガバナンス、データアーキテクチャ設計、マスタデータ管理などのエンタープライズデータ変革を支援しています。当社が目指しているのは、単なるデータ基盤構築ではなく、企業全体で共通のデータモデルとガバナンスを確立し、データドリブン経営やAI Transformationを実現するための土台を構築することです。

本ポジションでは、データの整流化・統制・活用に関する構想策定から実行までをリードし、顧客のデータ変革およびAI Transformationを推進していただきます。また、日本におけるEnterprise Data チームの成長を牽引する重要な役割も担っていただきます。

業務内容

- 複数の導入プロジェクト／提案案件の統括と、デリバリー品質の担保

- 顧客キーパーソン（情シス／業務部門／経営層）との合意形成、及び関係構築のオーナーシップ

-
日本語ネイティブ/N1レベル。日本語による職務経歴書の提出が可能であること（ドキュメンテーション能力を確認するため）

SnowPro Core (COF-C03)

Recruitment Background

As Japanese enterprises continue to accelerate their data transformation initiatives, Capgemini is expanding its Enterprise Data Practice in Japan. Leveraging our global experience and proven methodologies, we help major organizations introduce and establish global-standard data migration and data governance solutions as part of their large-scale business transformation programs.

We are looking for data consultants who can help clients address complex data challenges, including data strategy, governance, migration, quality, and analytics, while driving transformation initiatives from planning through execution.

Job Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee multiple implementation projects and proposal engagements, ensuring delivery quality.

- Own stakeholder management and consensus building with key client personnel, including IT departments, business units, and executive leadership.

- Lead the upstream design and decision-making process for migration, data cleansing, and governance strategies involving business data and enterprise applications (both on-premises and cloud-based).

- Oversee RFI/RFP responses and develop proposal strategies.

- Manage communication between product implementation teams (developers and data engineers) and clients, ensuring accurate translation of business requirements into technical specifications.

- Develop standardized implementation approaches and methodologies tailored to the Japanese market, while capturing reusable knowledge and best practices from project experiences.

- Deliver client-facing data consulting services under the direction and supervision of Capgemini project leaders.

- Support ongoing project delivery as well as pre-sales and proposal activities for new opportunities and subsequent project phases.

- Mentor team members and support resource allocation and staffing activities.

Required Qualifications (MUST)

- Native-level Japanese proficiency or JLPT N1 equivalent. Candidates must be able to provide a Japanese resume/CV, which will be used to assess documentation and written communication skills.

- Approximately 10+ years of experience designing system architectures involving business data and enterprise applications (both on-premises and cloud-based).

- Approximately 5+ years of consulting experience, including preparation of client-facing materials such as proposals, reports, and executive decision-making presentations.

- Proven experience leading the development of RFI/RFP response proposals.

- Possession of one of the following Associate- or Professional-level certifications, or equivalent hands-on experience:

SnowPro Core (COF-C03)
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional

SnowPro Advanced: Architect
SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer (DEA-C02)

Preferred Qualifications (NICE TO HAVE)

- Experience serving as a PM or PMO leading multiple teams and large-scale projects.

- Business-level English experience, particularly in collaboration with global product teams and overseas offices.

- Experience with SAP-related projects, including SAP S/4HANA migration and SAP ECC.

- Experience launching new services/practices or establishing standardized methodologies.

- Submission of a confidentiality-compliant portfolio showcasing previous deliverables and presentation materials.

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Able to bridge strategic planning and hands-on implementation, effectively operating at both levels.

- Enjoys designing solutions collaboratively with clients in situations where no established blueprint exists, particularly during the early stages of product adoption, while helping create a standardized approach for the Japanese market.

- Able to act as a translator between business and technology stakeholders, effectively communicating from executive leadership down to operational teams.

Required Qualifications (MUST)

- Native-level Japanese proficiency or JLPT N1 equivalent. Candidates must be able to provide a Japanese resume/CV, which will be used to assess documentation and written communication skills.

- Approximately 5+ years of experience in system architecture design, including business data systems and enterprise application packages in both on-premises and cloud environments.

- Approximately 3+ years of experience as a consultant creating client-facing materials such as proposals, reports, and decision-making documents.

- Experience leading the development of proposal documents in response to RFIs (Requests for Information) and RFPs (Requests for Proposals).

- Must possess one of the following foundation-level certifications, or have equivalent hands-on experience with data platform technologies:

-

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900)

- Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate

- SnowPro Associate: Platform

- Oracle Database SQL Certified Associate (1Z0-071)

6.  Practical experience in at least one of the following areas:

-

- Data Migration

- Data Modernization

- Data Governance

- Data Management

Preferred Qualifications (NICE TO HAVE)

- Experience driving projects as a Project Manager (PM) or Project Management Office (PMO).

- Professional experience working in English, including collaboration with overseas product teams and global offices.

- Experience in SAP-related projects, such as:

- SAP S/4HANA migration projects

- SAP ECC projects

- Ability to provide a portfolio of past deliverables (with confidential information appropriately redacted), such as proposals, reports, presentations, or other client-facing materials created in previous roles.

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Able to bridge strategy and execution, moving seamlessly between high-level planning and hands-on implementation.

Your Role

As a Digital Transformation Analyst in our Business Technology practice, you will support clients in shaping and executing business, IT, and digital transformation strategies. Your role will involve helping clients align their business and IT capabilities to drive operational efficiency, digital innovation, and business resilience.

You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, contribute to strategic analysis, and help design future-ready operating models and governance structures. This role is ideal for early-career professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems through a blend of strategic thinking, digital innovation, and technology insight.

What You'll Do

- Operationalise a business strategy on the planning and development of business structures and models to facilitate the evolution of a business to its desired future state

- Design or refine a solution blueprint or structure to guide the development of IT solutions in hardware, software, processes or related components, to meet current and future business needs

- Analyze IT and business cost structures, identify optimization opportunities, and support business cases for change

- Prepare client deliverables including presentations, reports, and models with clear insights and actionable recommendations

- Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in business, IT, and digital transformation

Your Profile

- Internship experience in a role like management consulting, IT strategy, or a corporate transformation office, with hands-on work in at least one of our core areas (large-scale program governance, enterprise architecture, IT operating model design, IT financial management, or AI strategy).

- Credibility in client-facing settings. You are comfortable leading a workshop, contributing to a steering committee, and producing clear, defensible deliverables.

- A degree in business, technology, or a related field, combined with a deep curiosity for technology and a demonstrated ability to learn complex topics quickly.

jobs.title: UX Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As UX Analytics Lead (Quantitative UX Research Lead) within Group IT, you will play a pivotal role in building a best in class UX organization by establishing and scaling analytics across a portfolio of enterprise products. This is a high impact role at the intersection of UX, product, and data, enabling teams to move from intuition driven to evidence based decision making.
You will transform user behavior data into actionable insights that directly influence product design, user experience, and measurable business outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how user experience is measured, understood, and continuously improved at scale.

Your Role

As UX Analytics Lead, you will establish and drive a data informed UX practice, enabling product and design teams to make better decisions based on real user behavior and measurable outcomes.
In this role, you will:
•    Analyze user behavior to identify friction points, usage patterns, and opportunities for UX improvement
•    Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for product managers, designers, and stakeholders
•    Combine quantitative and qualitative insights to explain not only what is happening, but also why
•    Define, standardize, and evolve UX metrics such as task success, drop off rates, engagement, and efficiency
•    Structure and analyze user journeys and funnels across key enterprise applications
•    Establish success criteria and measurement frameworks for features and product releases
•    Design and support experimentation, including A/B testing and feature validation
•    Build scalable UX analytics practices, including frameworks, dashboards, and best practices
•    Mentor designers and researchers in using data effectively within their workflows

Your Profile

•    5+ years of experience in product analytics, quantitative UX research, or a related field
•    Proven experience partnering closely with UX/design and product teams in product led environments
•    Strong track record of translating data into actionable product or design decisions
•    Hands on experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or similar
•    Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and define meaningful metrics
•    Experience with experimentation approaches such as A/B testing
•    Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar tools for data querying and analysis
•    Experience working within complex or enterprise environments

Your Career

Joining Capgemini means becoming part of a global community where you are empowered to shape your career. We support your growth through innovative projects, continuous learning, and a collaborative environment where technology and creativity come together.
In this role, you will help drive a shift toward data informed UX, directly impacting product adoption, user satisfaction, and operational efficiency. You will play a key role in defining how success is measured and how user behavior informs product evolution across the organization.
Get the future you want. With Capgemini.

Our vision is bold, and our mission is clear: to empower the business through technology that enables efficiency, profitability, and sustainable growth. We deliver enterprise wide solutions by harmonizing global standards and integrating all business units into a unified IT services model.
As a strategic partner to the business, Group IT translates complex needs into actionable initiatives, advocating for our stakeholders across the global technological landscape. We are currently driving a series of transformative rollouts and initiatives that enhance security, streamline operations, and elevate digital experiences for every Capgemini employee around the globe.

jobs.title: frog - Senior Manager, Sales & CRM Transformation
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client’s challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

frog is the reinvention and experience partner for the eco-digital era and the customer experience and design practice of Capgemini Invent. For six decades, frog has worked at the forefront of design and transformation. Today, our global network brings together designers, technologists, data scientists, and consultants to create and deliver differentiated experiences at scale.

Within frog’s Customer Transformation practice, we help clients reinvent how they engage customers, enable sellers, and drive profitable growth. We combine sales and CRM transformation, experience design, data, technology, and AI to create operating models and platforms that increase seller productivity, improve customer outcomes, and reduce cost to serve.

Your Role

As a Senior Manager, Sales & CRM Transformation, you will lead complex client engagements focused on transforming how organizations sell, serve customers, and manage revenue. You will advise clients on CRM strategy, sales operating models, agentic AI, seller productivity, and lead-to-cash transformation across Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and adjacent sales technologies.

You will work closely with practice leadership to shape pursuits and differentiated solutions, while maintaining accountability through delivery, production, adoption, and value realization. You will engage business and technology stakeholders at multiple levels, moving comfortably between executive discussions, seller journey workshops, operating model design, and architecture decisions. Your primary expertise will be CRM and sales transformation, complemented by a strong grounding in experience and service design.

Key responsibilities include:

- Lead enterprise CRM and sales transformation engagements across Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics 365, from current-state assessment and strategy through implementation, production, adoption, and value realization.

- Design future-state sales operating models, seller journeys, and transformation roadmaps that reduce seller friction, simplify touchpoints, improve customer engagement, and increase revenue per employee.

- Shape AI-enabled sales strategies involving agentic AI, agent assist, next best action, Customer 360, proactive insights, and cross-sell and up-sell orchestration, with appropriate governance and human oversight.

- Bring design thinking, journey mapping and service blueprinting to the work, so solutions are adopted rather than tolerated

- Co-lead business development, including client discovery, proposals, RFP responses, solution design, estimation, executive presentations, and follow-on opportunities, while defining scope and safeguarding delivery margin.

- Direct multidisciplinary teams across design, solution architecture, engineering, data, change management, and business transformation, while contributing to the practice through points of view, reusable assets, alliance relationships with Salesforce and Microsoft, and team development.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation.

The technical depth this role requires

You should be able to hold this conversation without slides.

- Architecture as a system: how CRM, CPQ, CLM, field service, ERP and billing, margin tracking and analytics connect across lead-to-cash, and what an agentic AI layer touches

- Salesforce and Dynamics 365: Sales, Service, Revenue and Data Cloud alongside Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service and Field Service, and how to advise a client that runs both

- Quote-to-cash and offer management: pricing logic, guided selling, approvals, offer and bundle management, and the ROI case for CPQ

- Agentic AI and seller productivity: agent assist, voice memo to opportunity, proactive insights and next best action, grounded in Customer 360 data and governed with human handoff

- Quota and compensation: quota and territory planning, incentive compensation and seller-facing quota views

- The economics that fund it: cost to serve, cost to sell, revenue per employee, win rate, deal margin and attach rate, in a business case that survives finance

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

- The confidence to be the technical authority in the room, and to move between a Chief Revenue Officer, a frontline seller and a solution architect in the same day

- A genuine design sensibility, with experience facilitating workshops and turning insight into solution requirements

- Storytelling and executive communication, in workshops, orals and steering committees

- A track record of holding delivery accountability after the sale rather than handing off at signature

Required Experience:

- Seven or more years for the Senior Manager level, in CRM and sales transformation, sales or revenue operations, enterprise technology transformation, or management consulting.

- Demonstrated experience leading enterprise Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 programs through production and adoption, with knowledge of sales, service, field service, CPQ, quote-to-cash, Customer 360, pricing, offer management, and related commercial processes.

- Practical understanding of agentic and generative AI applications in sales, including agent assist, proactive insights, next best action, seller productivity, and human-in-the-loop governance; experience with Salesforce Agentforce and Data Cloud or Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry is preferred.

- At least five years of experience leading teams or major workstreams, along with demonstrated business development contributions through proposals, solution shaping, estimation, executive presentations, and client relationship development.

- Experience applying design thinking, journey mapping, or service design within technology-enabled transformation; a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience and the ability to travel up to 30% are required. Relevant Salesforce or Microsoft certifications, experience with adjacent platforms such as Xactly, Varicent, Spiff, Clari, Gong, Conga, PROS, or Anaplan, and an MBA or related advanced degree are preferred.

Capgemini is seeking an experienced Workday Compensation Consultant with strong expertise in Core Compensation and Advanced Compensation. In this role, you will support client engagements across implementation, optimization, and Application Management Services environments.

You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to design, configure, test, deploy, and support scalable Workday Compensation solutions aligned with compensation and Total Rewards strategies.

Application Consultants understand the client business process, current and future, and map it to the technologies being used, giving a demarcation of what can be achieved through a standard implementation and what would need customizations or extensions to be done to the application. They may functionally customize the application, partner with application developers to design application enhancements and extensions, and work with business users to implement process changes.  Focus must be provided on building solutions and on maintaining, optimizing and improving a clients applications and systems. Application Consultant is responsible for unit testing, contribute to integration testing, andoror be responsible for the design and delivery of end user training. Your Role

- Support Workday Compensation workstreams across full-cycle implementations, tenant deployments, optimization initiatives, and AMS engagements.

- Gather business requirements, facilitate discovery workshops, and translate client needs into scalable Workday solutions.

- Support post-production activities and continuous system enhancements.

- Manage assigned deliverables across multiple client engagements while communicating risks, issues, and status updates.

- Bachelors Degree

- 4+ years of hands-on Workday experience, with a primary focus on Core Compensation and Advanced Compensation.

- Experience supporting Workday Compensation implementations, tenant deployments, optimization projects, or AMS engagements.

- Strong functional knowledge of Compensation Grades, Grade Profiles, Compensation Packages, Compensation Plans, and Compensation Business Processes.

- Hands-on experience configuring merit plans, bonus plans, compensation review processes, market adjustments, and stock or equity programs.

- Experience supporting annual compensation planning and review cycles.

- Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective Workday configurations.

- Experience conducting discovery sessions, requirements workshops, design reviews, and client presentations.

- Experience developing configuration documentation, functional designs, process flows, test scripts, and knowledge-transfer materials.

- Strong understanding of unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and production validation.

- Experience troubleshooting Workday Compensation configuration and process issues.

- Understanding of compensation governance, compliance requirements, and leading practices.

- Experience collaborating across Workday HCM, Talent, Recruiting, Payroll, Benefits, Security, Reporting, and Integrations.

- Familiarity with Workday integrations that impact Compensation, Payroll, Talent, and financial systems.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements in a consulting or managed services environment.

We are currently seeking a Senior AI Engineer Consultant with People Manager responsibility for a combined role where you will contribute as a Senior AI Engineer in client assignments while leading and developing a small team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists.

Your Role

In your role as a Senior AI Engineer, you will be part of a technical client assignment. You will be working on technical solutions and act as a Subject Matter Expert in Data, AI & ML. Collaboration with other engineering practices to optimize operations is key.

As People Manager, you will be responsible for a small team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering solutions to customers in industries such as defence, automotive, life science and others.

In this role you will play a key role in:

•    Recruiting new team members and having people management responsibility for your team
•    Supporting the Engineering Unit Manager with personnel management, business growth, and related activities
•    Working on technical customer proposals
•    Participating in technical project delivery and assignments for our clients
•    Recruitment, retention, mentorship of team members

You will be responsible for developing the team, fostering a healthy team spirit, and supporting consultants in their professional growth. Mentorship, coaching, and continuous feedback are essential aspects of this role. The position combines team leadership with active participation as a consultant in our project deliveries. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take their first or second step into a leadership role within a high-performing team environment.

Your Profile

•    PhD or Master's in computer science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, or related engineering fields.
•    5+ years of relevant industry experience with proficiency in Python, R, C++, and statistical data analysis.
•    Experience with databases (SQL, Elasticsearch), data management tools (Databricks, Snowflake), and data pipelines (Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop).
•    Familiarity with ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK).
•    Strong understanding of ETL processes and agentic workflows on cloud platforms. Ability to engage with external technology stakeholders.

Application

Vill du förändra världen? - Hjälpa våra kunder med molnarkitektur och cloud native lösningar.

- Använda dig utav generativ och agentisk AI.

- Du kommer att arbeta nära försäljnings- och leveransteam, andra chefer för att säkerställa att vi levererar högsta värde till våra kunder.

Din profil

- Minst 6 års erfarenhet och mycket goda kunskaper av implementation med molntjänster som AWS eller GCP.

- Minst 3 år som molnarkitekt och ansvarig för att sätta upp molnarkitektur, gärna med kunskaper om Amazons tolkning utav CAF, WAF, COM och OCA.

- Kunskap i ett eller flera programmeringsspråk, t.ex. Python, Java, Kotlin, Golang eller Node.

- Intresse för DevSecOps, generativ AI, agentisk AI och cloud-native lösningar.

- En naturlig ledare som vill utveckla andra. Väldigt positivt om du har tidigare erfarenhet med personalansvar.

- Flytande svenska och engelska kunskaper, i både tal och skrift.
