jobs.title: IT Process Consultant
jobs.description:
Word een leidende kracht in service integratie! Sluit je aan als IT Proces consultant en stuur complexe service-integratieprojecten aan voor toonaangevende klanten.

Jouw mogelijkheden als IT Proces Consultant bij Capgemini

Vanwege de sterke groei van ons team en de toenemende vraag van onze klanten, zijn we op zoek naar IT Proces Consultants om ons team te versterken. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service management en Service Integratie oplossingen. Je werkt samen met klanten en interne teams om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en best practices te implementeren. Je helpt bij het optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen en draagt zo bij aan het succes van onze klanten.

In het kort:

- Samenwerking: Werk nauw samen met consultants en ontwikkelaars om je kennis en vaardigheden te vergroten.

- Innovatie en Ontwikkeling: Neem deel aan het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen.

- Professionele Groei: Krijg de kans om deel te nemen aan design workshops, demo sessies, en vele interne opleidingsmogelijkheden bij onze Academie en interne opleidingsprogramma’s met de mogelijkheid tot het behalen van extern geaccrediteerde certificeringen. En bouw waardevolle relaties op met klanten en interne teams.

Jouw thuisbasis bij Capgemini

Internationale carrièremogelijkheden en fantastische expertise netwerken. Met meer dan 270.000 collega's wereldwijd en meer dan 7000 collega's alleen al in Nederland, word je omringd door een brede, technisch intensieve community van gemotiveerde collega's. Innovatieve, complexe- en uitdagende projecten voor bekende, vaak multinationale opdrachtgevers, ondersteund door wereld leidende partners en de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband bij een succesvolle internationale adviesorganisatie.

Het team waar je onderdeel van uit zult maken is verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van IT Management en Service Integratieoplossingen en biedt een breed scala aan diensten, van strategisch advies tot de levering en implementatie van projecten. Het team bestaat uit ervaren consultants die klanten adviseren bij het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service Management-oplossingen. Ze werken nauw samen met klanten om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en ondersteunen de ontwikkelaars en project- en commerciële teams. Daarnaast organiseren ze workshops met interne en externe stakeholders om de gebruikerservaring en acceptatie van het IT Service Management te verbeteren.

Benefits

- Direct een vast contract en een passend salaris.

-  Onbeperkt trainingen volgen bij onze  Academy .

- 26 vakantiedagen. Zin in een extra veel vrije tijd? Koop dan dagen bij.

- Capgemini draagt bij aan jouw pensioen. Daarnaast heb je ook de vrijheid om hier zelf nog extra aan bij te dragen.

- Werken waar je maar wilt met onze connectiviteits- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Uiteraard in overleg met de opdrachtgever.

- Een snelle laptop en een simkaart die je ook privé mag gebruiken.

- Een leaseauto, NS-businesscard of uitbetaling van je reiskostenvergoeding.

- Werken bij de beste IT opleider van Nederland!

Alles over onze het werken bij Capgemini

Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Als IT Proces Consultant bij Capgemini speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen en verbeteren van IT Service Management en Service Integration and Management-oplossingen, waardoor je direct bijdraagt aan het succes van onze klanten. Je werkt nauw samen met klanten en interne teams om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en best practices te verspreiden. Jouw bijdrage helpt ons bedrijven hun bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren en te transformeren.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief te kunnen samenwerken met klanten en interne teams.

- Kennis en ervaring met IT management, IT Governance, ITIL of andere beheer modellen. SIAM (Service Integration and Management) is een pre.

- Probleemoplossend vermogen om snel en creatief oplossingen te vinden voor complexe uitdagingen.

- Leergierigheid en bereid om continu te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een dynamische omgeving.

- Deze rol biedt je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen door bij verschillende klanten van Capgemini je kennis en ervaring te delen en te ontwikkelen.

Get the future you want

Die belofte doen wij aan jou. Dat begint al op dag één. Met een goede onboarding en gestructureerde en transparante groeipaden. Maar ook: volop mogelijkheden om daarvan af te wijken, zelf te pionieren en je eigen weg te kiezen. Daarbij kun je van onze kant rekenen op grenzeloos vertrouwen én collegiale support.

Werken bij Capgemini betekent ook werken in het internationale hart van de innovatie. De eredivisie van de technologie. Een werkgever met oog voor jou en het vizier op de toekomst, waarin  duurzaamheid  en  diversiteit en inclusie  de hoofdrollen spelen.

Eerst het team ontmoeten? Ook dat kan!

jobs.description:
Long Description

About Capgemini

At Capgemini, we help organizations transform their supply chain operations through innovative digital solutions, data-driven decision-making, and industry-leading expertise. We are seeking a talented Supply Chain Planning Consultant to join our Supply Chain Transformation team and support clients in optimizing planning processes across forecasting, replenishment, inventory management, and integrated business planning.

Role Overview

As a Supply Chain Planning Consultant, you will play a key role in helping clients design, implement, and optimize modern supply chain planning solutions. You will combine business process expertise, analytical thinking, and technology capabilities to deliver transformational solutions that drive measurable business value and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

- Support end-to-end Supply Chain Planning transformation and implementation projects across the full project lifecycle.

- Analyze current planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement across demand planning, supply planning, replenishment, forecasting, and inventory management.

- Gather, document, and translate business requirements into functional designs and future-state operating models.

- Configure and implement supply chain planning solutions aligned with client objectives and industry best practices.

- Facilitate client workshops, solution design sessions, training programs, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-live activities.

- Collaborate with business stakeholders, key users, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery.

- Support change management and user adoption initiatives to drive sustainable business outcomes.

- Provide functional expertise and guidance on supply chain planning processes and planning solution capabilities.

- Work closely with client teams, technology partners, and project leadership to resolve challenges and optimize solution performance.

- Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, client presentations, solution demonstrations, and thought leadership initiatives.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

- C1 German Level

- Proven experience in Supply Chain Planning, Supply Chain Transformation, Operations Consulting, or planning solution implementation projects.

- Strong understanding of:

- Demand Planning

- Forecasting

- Supply Planning

- Replenishment Planning

- Inventory Optimization

- Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

- Integrated Business Planning (IBP)

- Experience with supply chain planning platforms

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

- Client-focused mindset with strong consulting and relationship-building abilities.

- Ability to work effectively in diverse and international team environments.

- Fluency in English is required. German language skills are considered a strong advantage.

Preferred Experience

- Experience within retail, consumer products, manufacturing, or distribution industries.

- Exposure to large-scale supply chain transformation and digital planning initiatives.

- Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies.

- Experience supporting workshops, training sessions, and organizational change management activities.

jobs.title: Manager - Financial Crime & Compliance Consulting
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

Our Financial Services team helps banking and insurance organizations address complex financial crime, regulatory compliance, operational risk, and transformation priorities. We combine industry and regulatory expertise with strategy-through-execution capabilities to help clients strengthen controls, modernize operating models, and use digital, analytics, AI, and automation responsibly to improve compliance outcomes. The role may support clients across Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking, and Insurance in the United States.

Your Role

As a Manager – Financial Crime & Compliance Consulting , you will lead client engagements and workstreams focused on financial crime, regulatory compliance, and risk transformation for banking and insurance organizations. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape practical solutions, and guide multidisciplinary teams through the design and execution of target operating models, regulatory change initiatives, and AI-enabled transformation. You will be accountable for high-quality delivery, strong client relationships, team development, and the identification of opportunities to create additional client value.

Key responsibilities include:

- Lead engagement teams and workstreams delivering financial crime and compliance advisory and transformation initiatives, using analytics, automation, and AI-enabled approaches where they can improve insight, efficiency, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.

- Advise senior client stakeholders on financial crime, regulatory compliance, operational risk, and strategic priorities, translating complex requirements into clear decisions, transformation roadmaps, and executable actions.

- Design and implement target operating models for compliance, risk, and financial crime functions, including organization design, governance, processes, controls, data, technology, and responsible AI considerations.

- Shape digital and AI-enabled transformation initiatives across areas such as transaction monitoring, KYC and customer due diligence, sanctions screening, fraud, regulatory compliance, and case-management modernization.

- Manage delivery from scoping and work planning through resource and budget management, quality assurance, and client reporting, while developing junior consultants, supporting proposals, and contributing to thought leadership and practice assets.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring deep expertise in Financial Crime and Compliance, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), KYC/CDD, sanctions, fraud risk management, transaction monitoring, and regulatory compliance. You understand how emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities are transforming financial crime functions and helping organizations strengthen risk management, improve operational effectiveness, and meet evolving regulatory expectations. You are able to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and data-driven insights to enhance compliance outcomes, optimize processes, and support large-scale transformation initiatives. You collaborate effectively across compliance, risk, operations, technology, and data teams to design and deliver innovative solutions, with a strong appreciation for governance, regulatory requirements, responsible AI principles, privacy, security, and model risk considerations. You demonstrate intellectual curiosity, a continuous learning mindset, and a passion for helping financial institutions navigate an increasingly complex regulatory and financial crime landscape.

Required Experience:

- 10–15 years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience in financial crime and compliance within the US banking or insurance market, including areas such as AML, KYC and customer due diligence, sanctions, fraud, transaction monitoring, or regulatory compliance.

- Proven management consulting experience, or equivalent internal consulting or advisory experience within a financial institution, with demonstrated success leading client-facing teams and complex transformation work.

- Experience designing or implementing target operating models for compliance, risk, or financial crime functions, together with strategic advisory experience in operating-model assessments, business-case development, or regulatory change.

- Practical familiarity with AI-enabled and digital transformation, including automation, machine-learning applications in financial crime detection, intelligent case management, or analytics-driven compliance solutions; an understanding of responsible AI, governance, privacy, and security is also expected.

- Subject-matter depth in at least one of the following sectors: Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking, or Insurance.

- Strong understanding of the US regulatory environment relevant to financial crime and compliance, including applicable BSA/AML, OFAC, FinCEN, OCC, Federal Reserve, FINRA, or state insurance regulatory considerations.

- Excellent executive communication, stakeholder-influencing, client-management, and people-leadership skills, including experience coaching and developing consulting teams.

- Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or other relevant advanced degree is preferred. Relevant certifications such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, or CFCS are preferred; a project or program management certification is a plus.

- Willingness and ability to travel to client sites as required.

Senior Product Managers own the strategy, definition, and delivery of physical and digital products and services at the engagement level - not a single workstream. You balance vision, strategy, data, design, and execution, and you're accountable when a client's senior stakeholders ask why the product function is or isn't working.

You own the client relationship with senior stakeholders (VP/Head of Product level), not just the day-to-day conversation. You originate the perspectives and value-oriented approaches that shape how an engagement's product function runs, and you're expected to actively grow frog's presence on the account and in the market.

- Track record of owning product strategy and go-to-market for at least one major product line, platform, or 0-to-1 launch

- Executive-level presence: proven ability to advise and influence VP/C-suite client stakeholders

- Deep fluency in Agile/lean product operating models, including standing one up inside a client organization

- Proficiency with contemporary prototyping and research tools and methods

- Demonstrated experience directing or advising on the use of AI/GenAI/agentic capabilities within a product strategy or roadmap - not just personal tool usage, but a track record of making the call on where these capabilities belong in a client's product operating model. jobs.description:
Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology. We’re inventing the future of customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, brand engagements and communications.

Joining frog means you’ll be joining the “pond,” a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table. We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community — and the world at large.

About the Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

Within frog's Product & Tech team, we partner with organizations to define, build, and scale innovative physical and digital products, services, and experiences. We combine product strategy, customer-centered design, technology, data, and delivery excellence to help clients bring new ideas to market, accelerate innovation, and create measurable business value.

Your Role

As a Product Manager , you will support clients in defining, developing, and delivering products and services that balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams of designers, engineers, researchers, strategists, and business stakeholders to shape product vision, define requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and guide successful delivery.

You will be responsible for leading product workstreams, facilitating stakeholder alignment, and applying product management best practices to help organizations create customer-centered solutions that drive business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Analyst (Mission Critical Communications Hub)
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Through our Mission Critical Communication hub, you will help shape the future of secure communications in Sweden. Working at the intersection of technology, resilience, and public safety, you will contribute to solutions that strengthen society's preparedness for the future. Join us for a career full of opportunities, where you can make a difference and where no two days are the same.

Your role

As a Risk & Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for strengthening the organization's regulatory and cyber resilience within the telecom security domain through compliance management, security risk analysis, and end-to-end support of homologation, type approval, and product security certification activities.

In this role you will play a key role in:

•    Interpreting and operationalizing telecom security regulations, directives, and standards — including NIS2, the EU Cybersecurity Act and European certification framework, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), the Radio Equipment Directive (RED) cybersecurity requirements, 3GPP/GSMA NESAS-SCAS, and ISO/IEC 27001
•    Conducting systematic security and compliance risk analyses across network products, infrastructure, cloud-native platforms, and 5G core environments, identifying gaps, quantifying and prioritizing risk, and defining risk treatment and remediation plans
•    Coordinating and supporting homologation, type approval, and product security certification, including preparing technical and conformity documentation, liaising with accredited test laboratories, certification bodies, and regulators, and steering products through NESAS/SCAS, RED (EN 18031), Common Criteria/EUCC, and applicable national approval schemes.
•    Building and maintaining compliance evidence, control mappings, and certification artefacts, and preparing the organization for internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and customer assessments
•    Establishing and maintaining compliance, risk, and homologation methodologies, standards, and reporting frameworks, producing risk and compliance status reporting for management, and driving continuous improvement as regulations, certification schemes, and the telecom threat landscape evolve.

Your profile
•    Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
•    Min 8-10 years of experience in cybersecurity testing, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security assessment, or cybersecurity operations environments.
•    Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, risk management principles and security controls
•    Experience with vulnerability assessment and security testing tools, including platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Nessus, Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Microsoft Defender, or similar

What we believe you will enjoy about working here

- What we believe you will enjoy about working here

- Working alongside leading experts in Mission Critical Communications.

- Being part of a collaborative community supporting the organizations that society depends on most.

- Operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution in complex mission-critical environments.

- An inclusive culture that encourages learning and knowledge sharing, with opportunities for certifications, mentoring and professional growth.

Application
This role requires EU citizenship and is subject to security classification, meaning that a security screening will be carried out in accordance with Swedish legislation.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Business Development Director

Capgemini har sterke fagmiljøer, etablerte kunder og betydelig kapasitet nasjonalt. På Vestlandet ser vi et stort vekstpotensial, og for å styrke vår kommersielle tilstedeværelse i regionen etablerer vi nå en ny rolle med ansvar for å utvikle nye kunderelasjoner, identifisere nye markedsmuligheter og drive vekst i Bergen og Vestland.

Hos Capgemini Bergen er vi rundt 160 medarbeidere med kompetanse innen teknologi, rådgivning og digital transformasjon. Vi er stolte av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy fagkompetanse, der samarbeid, kunnskapsdeling og faglig utvikling står sentralt. Vi holder til i nye og moderne lokaler i Eldoradogården, midt i Bergen sentrum.

Om rollen

Vestlandet er en av Norges mest spennende regioner for teknologi- og forretningsutvikling. Virksomheter på tvers av bransjer står midt i omfattende endringer drevet av digitalisering, data, AI og nye forretningsmodeller. Dette gjelder ikke minst innen energi, industri, shipping, logistikk og sjømat, som er blant våre viktigste satsingsområder i regionen.

Vi ser etter en erfaren kommersiell leder som vil være med på å videreutvikle Capgeminis posisjon i Bergen og på Vestlandet. Du får ansvar for å bygge nye relasjoner, utvikle nye muligheter og bidra til videre vekst i regionen, med noen av Norges sterkeste fagmiljøer i ryggen.

Som Business Development Director får du ansvar for å identifisere, utvikle og vinne nye kunder og markedsmuligheter i regionen.

Du vil jobbe tett med våre fagmiljøer innen:

- Data og AI

- Cloud

- Cybersikkerhet

- Forretningsapplikasjoner

- Industriell digitalisering

- Teknologirådgivning

Du vil bygge strategiske kunderelasjoner og utvikle nye forretningsmuligheter som skaper verdi for kundene og vekst for Capgemini.

Du vil blant annet:

- Utvikle nye kunderelasjoner og bygge en kundeportefølje på Vestlandet

- Etablere relasjoner med beslutningstakere og identifisere forretningsutfordringer hvor Capgemini kan bidra med kompetanse og løsninger

- Lede salgsprosesser fra første dialog til avtale

- Utvikle tilbud og verdiforslag i samarbeid med våre fag- og leveransemiljøer i Norge og internasjonalt

- Bidra til å styrke Capgeminis synlighet og posisjon i regionen

Du får et tydelig mandat, stor påvirkningskraft og frihet til å forme hvordan vi skal vokse videre i Vestland.

Samtidig blir du en del av et globalt selskap med over 420 000 medarbeidere, med nærhet til beslutninger og gode muligheter til å påvirke utviklingen i regionen.

Hos oss får du:

- Et tydelig vekstmandat med sterke fagmiljøer og kompetanse i ryggen

- Mulighet til å jobbe med noen av Norges mest spennende virksomheter

- Konkurransedyktige betingelser og bonusordning

- Fleksibel arbeidshverdag

- Gode utviklingsmuligheter nasjonalt og internasjonalt

Din profil

Vi tror du motiveres av ansvar, frihet og muligheten til å skape synlige resultater.

Du har sannsynligvis erfaring fra ett eller flere av følgende områder:

- Konsulentbransjen

- Teknologibransjen

- Industri- eller energisektoren

- Maritim sektor eller logistikk

- Forretningsutvikling eller strategisk B2B-salg

Du trenger ikke å komme fra et bestemt selskap eller ha en bestemt utdanning. Det viktigste er at du kan vise til dokumenterte resultater fra komplekse salgs- eller forretningsutviklingsroller.

Vi tror også at du:

- Har høy kommersiell forståelse og god innsikt i teknologiens rolle i forretningsutvikling

- Er trygg i dialog med ledere og beslutningstakere

- Trives med å åpne nye dører og utvikle nye muligheter

- Er strukturert, gjennomføringssterk og kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk

Søknad

For spørsmål om rollen kan du kontakte Lars H. Sandvik-Jacobsen, Regional Director (lars.jacobsen@capgemini.com) eller Synnøve Haugland Bjorøy, Talent Acquisition Specialist ( synnove.bjoroy@capgemini.com ).

Søknadsfrist: 20. oktober

Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.

Arbeidssted er Bergen.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini er et ledende globalt konsulentselskap som hjelper kunder med omstilling og digitalisering. Med kunstig intelligens, teknologi og mennesker jobber vi for å fornye og forbedre organisasjoner. Vi har nesten 60 års erfaring og 420,000 ansatte i mer enn 50 land. Sammen med sterke partnere leverer vi ende-til-ende tjenester og løsninger basert på solid bransjeforståelse og kompetanse på strategi, design, teknologi og drift. Konsernet hadde i 2024 inntekter på 22,1 milliarder euro globalt.

Capgemini Engineering, leader mondial des services d'ingénierie, rassemble des équipes d'ingénieurs, de scientifiques et d'architectes pour aider les entreprises les plus innovantes dans le monde à libérer leur potentiel.

Des voitures autonomes aux robots qui sauvent des vies, nos experts en technologies digitales et logicielles sortent des sentiers battus en fournissant des services uniques de R&D et d'ingénierie dans tous les secteurs d'activité.

Rejoignez-nous pour une carrière pleine d'opportunités, où vous pouvez faire la différence et où aucun jour ne se ressemble.

À propos de l'offre :

Nous recherchons un Gestionnaire Achats Opérationnels Junior , titulaire d'un Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Achats, Supply Chain, Gestion ou Commerce de 0 à 3 ans d'experience, pour rejoindre notre équipe à Casablanca et assurer la gestion des achats de faible valeur pour les périmètres France et Allemagne.

Le candidat participera à la gestion de bout en bout des demandes d'achats, depuis la qualification du besoin jusqu'au suivi des commandes fournisseurs. Il collaborera étroitement avec les équipes métiers, les fournisseurs et les différentes parties prenantes afin de garantir la qualité de service, le respect des procédures achats et la conformité des opérations.

Expérience

- Analyser et qualifier les besoins exprimés par les clients internes.

- Traiter les demandes d'achat dans les outils SAP et Ariba.

- Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs les plus adaptés selon les besoins et le panel existant.

- Créer, mettre à jour et assurer le suivi des fiches fournisseurs.

- Émettre les commandes d'achat et assurer leur suivi jusqu'à réception.

- Vérifier les accusés de réception et relancer les fournisseurs si nécessaire.

- Assurer le suivi des délais de livraison et gérer les priorités opérationnelles.

- Participer à la résolution des litiges simples liés à la facturation, aux livraisons ou à la qualité.

- Accompagner les parties prenantes internes sur les processus achats.

- Contribuer à l'intégration et à l'onboarding des nouveaux fournisseurs.

- Veiller au respect des procédures achats et des règles de conformité en vigueur.

Compétences techniques

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Consultant
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
Location

This is an onsite role based in Toranto, ON.

Your Role

Core Pillars of ETL maintenance and Development

- Pipeline Development:  Build and optimize scalable data integration processes using tools like SnapLogic, SSIS, Informatica, or Talent.

- Data Transformation:  Clean, deduplicate, and format data so it is reliable and consistent for end-users.

- Data Modeling:  Structure and define the storage of large-scale datasets within data warehouses or data lakes.

- Performance & Maintenance:  Troubleshoot pipeline failures, monitor data quality, and schedule continuous data updates.

- Cross-functional Collaboration:  Work with business analysts, data scientists, and solutions architects to align data workflows with business needs.

- Monitoring & Alerts:  Setting up automated logging and error notifications (e.g., using tools like Databricks ETL Tools) to catch pipeline failures before they impact business decisions.

- Incident Management:  Investigating failed jobs, identifying corrupted data, and applying hotfixes or triggering automated data-recovery routines.

- Performance Tuning:  Diagnosing bottlenecks and refining transformation logic to minimize processing overhead and ensure shorter maintenance windows.

- Source/Destination Updates:  Managing schema drift and updating connectors when third-party APIs or source databases change.

- Database Programming:  Develop and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and triggers to support business rules and reporting.

- Scripting & Automation:  Write and maintain Unix/Linux shell scripts (e.g., Bash, Korn) to automate batch processing, data extraction, and file transfers.

- System Support & Monitoring:  Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve database application issues and server faults. Ensure high availability for critical business applications.

- Performance Tuning:  Analyze execution plans, manage indexes, and fine-tune SQL queries and server configurations to improve throughput.

- Data Migration:  Build procedures to extract, transform, and load (ETL) large datasets between disparate systems and flat files.

- Collaboration:  Work alongside DBAs, developers, and QA teams to support deployment, maintenance, and system upgrades.

On-Premises vs. Cloud Support

- On-Premises:  Requires heavy, hands-on IT maintenance (managing hardware, software updates, and server downtime)

- Cloud & SaaS:  Providers usually handle infrastructure management, upgrades, and connector maintenance automatically, shifting the focus of your support team strictly to data quality and business logic.

Your Skills And Experience

- Unix

- Linux

- ETL

- SQL

- API

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Your role

In this role you will play a key role in:

- Partnering with leading organizations and multidisciplinary teams to transform data into strategic value.

- Helping clients make smarter decisions and gain real-time, actionable insights by leveraging advanced analytics, AI and intelligent automation and Agentic AI capabilities.

- Exploring how generative AI and Agentic AI can transform business processes, unlock new ways of working, and create sustainable competitive advantages for clients.

- Working across industries and geographies to co-create innovative solutions and reshape business models, unlock new growth opportunities, and deliver measurable impact.

Your profile

- Educational background: You hold a  master’s degree with strong academic results in fields such as Engineering, Business, Economics in combination with Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar. Ideally, you combine this with hands-on experience from internships, projects, or extracurricular activities.

- Recent graduate: You are graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated, with 0-3 years of relevant work experience since completing your degree.

- Skills and mindset: You’re analytical, curious, and passionate about data and AI driven innovation. You thrive in dynamic environments, learn quickly, and enjoy solving complex challenges- both independently and in teams.

- Additional merits: Experience with AI, Machine learning, Generative AI , Agentic applications, automation or data driven innovation is highly valued. International and professional experiences, as well as involvement in extracurricular activities, are also considered valuable assets.

- Language skills: You have fluent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

What you’ll love about working here

- Career development: Experience a well-defined career path with support to develop into a successful consultant, including training and mentoring programs.

- Collaborative culture: Benefit from our supportive teams, knowledge sharing and comprehensive end-to-end capabilities.

- Engaging workplace: Embrace a culture where employees shape their own future and enjoy a welcoming, social workplace with many exciting events and activities.

Need to know

Start date and location: As a recent graduate, you’ll join our Stockholm or Gothenburg office in Fall 2027, with readiness to travel and work on projects at our client sites. If you have already graduated, there may be an opportunity to start earlier, during Spring 2027.

Application process:  Applications are reviewed continuously, apply early to secure your spot. Please submit your CV in English along with your official transcripts from high school and university. Since the system only allows one upload field for grades (under “Cover Letter”), we kindly ask you to combine all your transcripts- high school, bachelor’s, and master’- into a single document before uploading. Clearly state your expected graduation date and preferred office location(s). Incomplete applications will not be considered.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card.

Next steps:  Our selection process includes several steps to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation:

- CV & grade screening

- Phone interview

- Video interview

- On-site group case

- Final interview

- Offer

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real |  www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: (Senior) Business Analyst Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mit Capgemini entscheidest du dich für ein Unternehmen, in dem du die Möglichkeit hast, deine Karriere so zu gestalten, wie du es dir wünscht. Indem du von einer kollaborativen Gemeinschaft von Kolleg/innen auf der ganzen Welt unterstützt und inspiriert wirst und die Chance hast, dir neue Möglichkeiten vorzustellen. Komm zu uns und hilf uns den weltweit führenden Organisationen, den Wert von Technologien zu zeigen und eine nachhaltigere, inklusivere Welt zu schaffen.
DEINE ROLLE

Start: März / April 2026, Vollzeit 40h/Woche

Als Business Analyst bei Capgemini bist du involviert in die Analyse, Gestaltung und Modellierung von Anforderungen. Deine Skills nutzt du, um Business und IT zusammenzubringen und Potenziale vor anderen zu erkennen.

In dieser Position wirst du eine wichtige Rolle spielen:

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung:  Von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-Live steuerst du eigenverantwortlich größere Themenbereiche – fachlich, strukturiert und mit Weitblick.

- Du denkst Prozesse neu:  Du analysierst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse, deckst Optimierungspotenziale auf und erkennst technische Abhängigkeiten.

- Du gestaltest Lösungen:  Du entwickelst High-Level-Lösungsdesigns, die nicht nur funktionieren, sondern sich nahtlos in die Gesamtarchitektur einfügen.

- Du bringst Ideen in den Sprint:  Du formulierst User Stories, begleitest Entwicklung und Testing und präsentierst die Ergebnisse in Sprint Reviews.

- Du bist Sparringspartner:  Ob Product Owner oder Abteilungsleitung – du unterstützt Entscheidungsträger/innen mit fundierten Analysen und überzeugenden Unterlagen.

DEIN PROFIL

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in komplexen Softwareprojekten, insbesondere in der Anforderungsanalyse großer IT-Systeme.

- Du bist mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban vertraut und arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie JIRA und Confluence.

- Du denkst analytisch, handelst proaktiv und bringst ein echtes agiles Mindset mit.

- Technisches Verständnis und idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung (Java/.NET) – vielleicht sogar als Product Owner.

- Du kommunizierst souverän – auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

WAS DIR BEI UNS BESONDERS GEFALLEN WIRD

- Wir verstehen die Bedeutung  flexibler Arbeitsregelungen , daher bieten wir HomeOffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten oder in ausgewählten EU-Staaten arbeiten mit unserem FlexAbroad Programm. Du erhältst ein Umfeld, in dem du eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten kannst.

- Das Herzstück unserer Mission ist deine  berufliche Entwicklung . Unser Angebot an Programmen für die berufliche Weiterbildung und verschiedenen Positionen ist darauf ausgerichtet, dich bei der Erkundung einer Welt voller Möglichkeiten zu unterstützen.

- Rüste dich mit  wertvollen Zertifizierungen  in den neuesten Technologien wie Atlassian und PEGA aus.

- Wir bieten Zusatzleistungen wie regelmäßige Team- und Firmenveranstaltungen, monatliche Essensgutscheine, die Jahreskarte der Wiener Linien, Massagen im Büro und vieles mehr.

Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte in Information und Consulting, Mindestgehalt von 60.000,- Euro brutto pro Jahr, marktkonforme Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung auf Englisch, ausschließlich über unser Bewerbungsportal und unter Angabe von Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Eintrittszeitpunkt.

Über Capgemini

Capgemini ist der Partner für die Geschäftstransformation im KI-Zeitalter. Das Unternehmen unterstützt Organisationen dabei, eine intelligente und nachhaltige Zukunft zu gestalten. Dabei verbindet Capgemini KI, Technologie sowie menschliche Kreativität und verändert somit, wie Unternehmen agieren, Innovationen vorantreiben und Wachstum generieren. Über Strategieentwicklung, Technologie, Engineering und Intelligent Operations hinweg verbindet das Unternehmen fundierte Branchenexpertise mit marktführenden Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen KI, Cloud und Daten. So entsteht aus ambitionierten Vorhaben echter, skalierbarer Geschäftserfolg. Seit fast 60 Jahren und gemeinsam mit einem starken Partnernetzwerk stehen 410.000 Mitarbeitende in mehr als 50 Ländern für Verantwortung wie auch Vielfalt. Die Gruppe erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von 22,5 Milliarden Euro.

Make it real   |   www.capgemini.com/at-de

jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Location

This is a hybrid role based in Seattle, WA

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is hiring Functional Consultants / Business Analysts across junior, intermediate and senior bands to support a large, complex Teamcenter-based PLM modernization for a major Aerospace & Defense OEM. You are the bridge between engineering and manufacturing users and the PLM solution - capturing requirements, mapping functional scope and validating the build, within a blended onshore–offshore team.

Your Role

- Capture and structure functional requirements from engineering and manufacturing stakeholders.

- Map legacy PDM / process-planning functional scope (levels 0–2) onto Teamcenter capabilities.

- Identify and document augmented-engineering / AI use cases (AI-assisted requirements, change impact, work instruction generation).

- Document as-is / to-be processes - change control, configuration, BOM and work-instruction flows.

- Support configuration, test and validation of the Teamcenter solution against requirements.

- Collaborate across the onshore–offshore team (onshore core + offshore center), mirroring the client; senior band runs user workshops and leads scope mapping.

Your Skills and Experience

- 2 to 10 Years of experience as PLM Functional Consultant/PLM Business Analyst (Required junior, intermediate and senior folks)

- Requirements capture, documentation, test support.

- Owns functional areas; runs workshops; drives scope mapping.

- Leads functional domains, workshops and AI use cases; deeper Teamcenter expertise.

- PLM functional / business-analysis experience appropriate to the band (see matrix).

- Ability to capture requirements and map functional scope in an engineering context.

- Understanding of core PLM processes - BOM, change control, configuration, process planning.

- Comfort collaborating across onshore–offshore teams; strong stakeholder-facing skills.

jobs.title: Security Consultant - Penetration Testing & DevSecOps
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
Location

This is a remote role based in the US.

About The Job You're Considering

We are seeking a Senior Security Consultant - Penetration Testing & DevSecOps with 5-8 years of cybersecurity experience and strong expertise in application penetration testing, offensive security, DevSecOps, SSDLC, and vulnerability management. The role focuses on conducting security assessments across applications, APIs, cloud environments, and CI/CD pipelines, while collaborating with development and engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills, a proactive security mindset, and the ability to communicate risks effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.

Your Role

Penetration Testing & Offensive Security

- Perform manual and automated penetration testing of web applications, APIs, mobile applications, cloud environments, and supporting infrastructure.

- Conduct reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and post-exploitation activities following industry-standard methodologies such as OWASP, PTES, NIST, and MITRE ATT&CK.

- Identify security vulnerabilities, validate exploitability, assess business risk, and provide actionable remediation recommendations.

- Execute security assessments against modern architectures including microservices, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native applications.

- Develop proof-of-concepts to demonstrate security weaknesses and attack paths.

- Prepare detailed technical reports and executive summaries for customers and stakeholders.

DevSecOps & Secure SDLC

- Integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines.

- Implement and manage SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, Secrets Detection, and API Security testing solutions.

- Collaborate with development teams to remediate vulnerabilities and adopt secure coding practices.

- Participate in security architecture reviews, threat modeling exercises, and secure design assessments.

- Automate security testing and compliance validation within DevOps toolchains.

- Develop security guardrails and policy-as-code capabilities to improve software security posture.

Vulnerability Management & Security Engineering

- Perform vulnerability triage, risk prioritization, and remediation tracking.

- Support continuous security monitoring and risk assessment activities.

- Analyze emerging threats, attack techniques, and security trends to improve testing methodologies.

- Assist in development of security standards, procedures, and best practices.

- Work with engineering, cloud, and infrastructure teams to enhance organizational security posture.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Present findings and recommendations to developers, architects, engineering teams, and leadership.

- Provide security consulting throughout the software development lifecycle.

Your Skills And Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

- 5-8 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience.

- Minimum 3+ years of experience conducting application and API penetration testing.

- Experience implementing or supporting DevSecOps initiatives within CI/CD environments.

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of:

- Web Application Security

- API Security

- Secure SDLC

- OWASP Top 10

- OWASP API Top 10

- MITRE ATT&CK

- Threat Modeling

- Vulnerability Management

- Hands-on experience with:

- Burp Suite Professional

- Nmap

- Nessus / Qualys / Tenable

- Metasploit

- Kali Linux

- Checkmarx

- Veracode

- Snyk

- SonarQube

- GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps / Jenkins

Desired Qualifications

Certifications :

One or more of the following certifications:

- OSCP (Preferred)

- CRTO

- PNPT

- CEH

- GWAPT

- GPEN

- CISSP

- CCSP

- Azure Security Engineer Associate

- AWS Security Specialty

Additional Skills :

- Experience with container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Experience conducting cloud penetration testing.

- Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

- Familiarity with Red Team methodologies and adversary simulation.

- Experience with AI/LLM security testing is a plus.

- Exposure to Zero Trust Architecture and Secure-by-Design principles.

- Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: frog - Interaction Design - Sr. Consultant
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our clients’ challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for professionals who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how products, services, and experiences are designed.

Joining frog means becoming part of “the pond,” a global network of studios whose people are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by a passion for improving the human experience through design. At our San Francisco and New York studios, you will work alongside designers, strategists, technologists, and researchers to solve complex challenges and create innovative, sustainable solutions that move markets and connect with people.

As part of Capgemini Invent, frog combines diverse skills across design, strategy, technology, and data to unleash growth, build superior experiences, and create lasting impact at scale. Our culture prizes craft, curiosity, community, performance, and outcomes, providing the freedom to make a meaningful contribution through client work, within the studio, and across the broader design community.

Your Role

As a Senior Interaction Designer at frog, you will shape digital products and services from early-stage concepts through detailed design and implementation. You will bring a broad skill set across interaction, service, and visual design to develop holistic, human-centered solutions for clients across a range of industries. You will apply strategic thinking and design craft throughout the design process, moving between divergent exploration and convergent decision-making while using AI as a working partner. As a senior individual contributor, you will also mentor junior designers, contribute to frog’s global design community, lead client conversations within your domain, and help guide critical design decisions.

Depending on the engagement, you may lead small project teams and contribute to business development through proposal development and client pitches.

Key responsibilities include:

-
Define opportunity areas and experience requirements based on a deep understanding of users’ needs, business objectives, constraints, and market context.

-
Adapt design approaches, methods, and levels of rigor to fit the needs of each client, project, industry, and delivery environment.

-
Lead client workshops and cross-disciplinary analysis to align stakeholders, deepen user understanding, and identify meaningful design opportunities.

-
Shape high-quality digital product and experience concepts in collaboration with strategy, research, technology, and other design partners.

-
Plan, conduct, and synthesize research, testing, and piloting activities with service users, providers, clients, and subject-matter experts.

-
Design wireframes, screens, interaction patterns, and prototypes, carrying defined experiences through detailed design across multiple service or product components.

-
Work effectively within established visual systems while ensuring consistency, usability, accessibility, and attention to design detail.

-
Use AI tools across research synthesis, ideation, concept development, testing, and prototyping, applying human judgment to evaluate and refine AI-generated outputs.

-
Communicate the story, rationale, and value of the work through compelling presentations, design narratives, and client recommendations.

-
Document product and service requirements, design specifications, interaction behaviors, and implementation guidelines.

-
Mentor and guide junior colleagues, contribute to frog’s design community of practice, and support the continued advancement of interaction-design craft.

-
Lead client conversations within the interaction-design domain and provide articulate, evidence-based recommendations that guide client decisions.

-
Contribute to proposal writing, pitches, and other business-development activities when required.

Your Skills + Experience

Application Requirement

As part of the application, candidates must include a link to or PDF of a recent portfolio demonstrating experience relevant to the role. The portfolio should provide specific examples of the candidate’s design approach, thought process, collaboration style, and contribution to successful design outcomes. Applications submitted without a portfolio cannot be accepted.

You are a human-centered, strategic designer who can move from early concepts through detailed execution. You bring strong interaction-design craft, curiosity, commercial awareness, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. You also use AI and GenAI tools to support research, ideation, testing, and prototyping, applying human judgment to refine outputs and create meaningful user experiences.

Required Experience:

- 5+ years of professional experience in interaction design or a related role, such as UX Designer or Product Designer.

- Strong interaction-design skills demonstrated through a portfolio of recent work.

- Experience developing digital-product concepts, interaction models, wireframes, screens, components, and prototypes.

- Ability to move between strategic, conceptual thinking and high-quality detailed design.

- Experience conducting and synthesizing qualitative and quantitative design research.

- Advanced proficiency in Figma, particularly interaction logic, component design, and prototyping.

- Experience collaborating in multidisciplinary teams as a senior contributor or experience-design lead.

- Working knowledge of current AI and GenAI tools, with experience applying them to synthesis, ideation, testing, and prototyping.

- Strong client-facing communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.

- Strategic and commercial awareness, with the ability to connect design decisions to user needs and business outcomes.

- Alignment with frog’s values and passion for creating products and experiences that address people’s functional and emotional needs.

- Residency in the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City area, with a willingness to travel for research, client meetings, and project delivery.

Preferred Experience:

- Degree in Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related design or behavioral-science field.

- Experience designing or prototyping GenAI-enabled products, including LLM-based products, agentic systems, multimodal interactions, or generative content capabilities.

- Experience across start-up, corporate, agency, or consulting environments.

- Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Lean, or Waterfall delivery methods.

- Knowledge of accessibility best practices, tools, and standards.

- Additional professional, academic, cultural, or language experience that brings a broader perspective to design.

Location

Must be local or willing to relocate to Los Angeles, CA. -   Ability to support 100% onsite environment as needed - required

About the Job You're Considering

Capgemini is seeking an experienced SAP Program/Engagement Manager - SAP Plant Maintenance/EAM  to lead large-scale SAP transformation programs for strategic clients. This role requires a strong combination of SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) expertise, program leadership, financial management, and executive stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record delivering complex SAP programs valued at $10M-$15M+ , managing client relationships, driving governance, and leading transformation initiatives from strategy through execution.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, lead steering committee discussions, oversee project financials, manage contractual commitments, and ensure successful business outcomes through SAP-enabled transformation programs.

Program Managers are responsible for overseeing the project/engagement/contract/activity on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project/engagement communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.   Responsible for leading either a large contractorengagement or a definable segment of a very large and complex contractorengagement. Clients may be external or internal. PM are responsible for the translation of the clients complex business requirements into formal agreements. For these, PM establish specific solutions, applications or processes which ultimately culminate in customer acceptance of the results. This includes working with client team members and executives to identify business requirements and subsequently working with, and leading others, in the initiating, planning, controlling, executing and closing the clients solution. PM are responsible for a wide range of process activities beginning with the request for proposal through development, and final delivery.

Your Role

- Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale SAP transformation programs and strategic client engagements valued at $10M-$15M+ .

- Establish and manage program governance, delivery frameworks, project plans, milestones, resource strategies, and risk mitigation plans.

- Own project financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, revenue management, profitability, margin optimization, and financial reporting.

- Serve as the primary client-facing leader, building trusted relationships with executives, business stakeholders, and delivery teams.

- Lead executive governance meetings, steering committees, status reviews, and CXO-level presentations.

- Manage Statements of Work (SOWs), Change Requests (CRs), contract compliance, funding approvals, and commercial governance.

- Develop business cases, investment proposals, and executive presentations to support strategic decision-making.

- Partner with business and technical stakeholders to design and deliver enterprise asset management solutions that drive operational excellence and business value.

- Collaborate with global and cross-functional teams to ensure delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and customer satisfaction.

- Provide leadership in issue resolution, escalation management, organizational change, and transformation adoption activities.

Your Skills and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.

- 10+ years of project and program management experience, including leadership of complex enterprise transformation initiatives.

- 5+ years of experience managing large-scale SAP or ERP programs with budgets exceeding $10M-$15M .

- Proven experience serving as an Engagement Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Lead within consulting or professional services environments.

- Strong hands-on expertise in SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) , SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) , and SAP S/4HANA EAM .

- Deep understanding of asset management processes, maintenance operations, reliability programs, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

- Demonstrated success managing project financials, revenue forecasting, profitability, budgeting, and cost control.

- Extensive experience with SOW development, contract management, change control processes, and Change Request (CR) governance.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to lead CXO, Steering Committee, and executive stakeholder discussions.

- Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience leading global delivery teams, matrix organizations, and distributed project teams.

- Strong business and technology acumen with the ability to align transformation initiatives to business outcomes.

- Experience with SAP integrations and complementary modules such as SAP MM, FICO, Project Systems (PS), and related SAP solutions preferred.

- Experience leading SAP S/4HANA transformation, ERP modernization, and digital transformation programs preferred.

- PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent project management certifications preferred.

- Experience in Manufacturing, Utilities, Energy, Oil & Gas, Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, or other asset-intensive industries preferred.

- Demonstrated strengths in financial management, client relationship management, strategic planning, risk management, negotiation, conflict resolution, and executive communication.

jobs.description:
At Capgemini FS, we shape the future of financial services.

As a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business through technology, we blend deep industry expertise with cutting-edge capabilities in Data & AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation.

The Belgian banking sector is undergoing a profound evolution, driven by shifting regulations, rapid technological disruption, and changing customer expectations. Capgemini FS Belgium is uniquely positioned to lead this wave of modernization.
Backed by our powerful global network and strategic alliances with industry giants like Microsoft, AWS, and Google, we have set highly ambitious growth targets for the Belgian financial market.

We are not just expanding our footprint; we are redefining how Belgium’s major financial institutions innovate, scale, and deliver value.
To drive this strategic expansion, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Business Development Director who possesses the executive presence, industry trust, and vision to position Capgemini as the absolute partner of choice for C-suite banking executives in Belgium.
Job Description

A sales manager manages a team of salespeople within a defined industry sector, business line and/or geography. He/she also personally supports salespeople in driving sales opportunities from detection to closure, helping them find internally the relevant resources they may need.
He/She is accountable for the quality of sales data and provides accurately sales forecast consolidating a vision of his team sales activity, according to a budget he sets up to each sales individual
He takes care of the motivation of his teams and support its members in defining and achieve their professional develpment

Job Description - Grade Specific

Is able to handle deep conversations on some parts of Capgeminis portfolio and to negotiate with CxOs for strategic deals
Influences Capgemini portfolio evolution through insights on clients priorities and investments
Goes beyond closing deals and tries to build long term relationships with clients, acting as an advisor vs. salesperson
Identifies, qualifies deals and is able to determine the set of solutions to complex or strategic issues faced by clients
Clearly communicates expectations towards sales team members, supports in finding sales opportunities, creates the conditions to success and manages commitment

Senior Business Development Director – Banking Sector Belgium

Location: Belgium
Languages: Fluent Dutch (Flemish) and English mandatory. French is a strong asset.
Experience: Minimum 10 years of Business Development and Sales experience within the Financial Services industry.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Business Development Director to drive the growth of Capgemini's Banking business in Belgium. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, shaping, and closing strategic opportunities across the Belgian banking and financial services market. This role requires an established network within the Belgian banking industry, a proven track record of winning multi-million euro transformation deals, and the ability to engage credibly with C-level executives on both business and technology transformation topics. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to clients and a key contributor to Capgemini's growth ambitions within the Financial Services sector.

Key Responsibilities

Business Growth & Sales Leadership

- Develop and execute the Banking sales strategy for the Belgian market.

- Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities across existing and new clients.

- Achieve and exceed annual sales, bookings, revenue, and profitability targets.

- Lead complex pursuit and deal qualification processes from opportunity creation to contract signature.

- Drive revenue growth by positioning the full breadth of Capgemini capabilities including Consulting, Technology Services, Data & AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Intelligent Operations.

Executive Client Engagement

- Build trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Data Officers, Chief Risk Officers, and senior business executives.

- Act as a strategic advisor to client leadership teams on industry trends, digital transformation, customer experience, operational excellence, AI, data, regulatory compliance, and modernization initiatives.

- Facilitate executive workshops and business discussions focused on tangible business value creation.

Market Development

- Leverage an extensive personal network within the Belgian banking ecosystem.

- Identify emerging market trends and growth opportunities.

- Develop and maintain relationships with industry associations, regulators, technology partners, and strategic influencers.

- Represent Capgemini at industry conferences, client events, and executive roundtables.

Collaborative Selling

- Lead multidisciplinary pursuit teams across Capgemini entities.

- Coordinate with Client Partners, Delivery Executives, Consulting leaders, Solution Architects, and Alliance Partners.

- Promote a "One Capgemini" approach by bringing together the best capabilities and experts to address client challenges.

- Build strategic partnerships with key technology ecosystem players including Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS, Google, Databricks, ServiceNow, and others.

Opportunity Shaping & Deal Leadership

- Qualify opportunities, define win strategies, and shape compelling value propositions.

- Lead client presentations, proposal development, negotiation, and commercial discussions.

- Ensure strong governance, deal quality, and profitability throughout the sales lifecycle.

- Drive executive sponsorship and stakeholder alignment internally and externally.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Professional Experience

- Minimum 10 years of successful Business Development, Sales, Account Management, or Client Leadership experience within the Banking or Financial Services industry.

- Demonstrated track record of winning large-scale transformation engagements and managed services contracts.

- Experience selling consulting, AI technology, digital transformation, data, cloud, cybersecurity, or operational transformation services.

- Strong understanding of banking business models, regulatory environment, and market dynamics.

Industry Network

- Established and active network within Belgian banks and financial institutions.

- Ability to access and engage senior decision makers.

- Proven credibility with both business and technology stakeholders.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

- Entrepreneurial mindset with strong hunting capabilities.

- Strategic thinker with excellent commercial acumen.

- Outstanding communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

- Executive presence with the ability to influence at C-suite level.

- Collaborative leader capable of mobilizing large virtual teams.

- Results-oriented with a passion for growth and client success.

Education

- Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

- MBA or advanced business qualification is a plus.

Languages

- Native or near-native Dutch/Flemish.

- Fluent English.

- French highly desirable.

Success Metrics

The successful candidate will be measured on:

- Annual bookings and revenue growth.

- Strategic opportunity pipeline development.

- Client relationship expansion and executive sponsorship.

- New logo acquisition and account penetration.

- Win rate and deal conversion effectiveness.

- Cross-capability and ecosystem sales collaboration.

- Contribution to Capgemini's Banking market position in Belgium.

By applying to this vacancy, you agree with a background or reference check if applicable.

jobs.title: Oracle Cloud Program Manager & Portfolio Delivery
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
About the Job You're Considering

We are looking for a senior Oracle Cloud Program Manager to lead large, complex Oracle Cloud SaaS programs across Financials (ERP), SCM, HCM, EPM and CX. You will own delivery end to end for multi-pillar, multi-country deployments, leading onshore and offshore techno-functional teams and acting as the client's main point of contact for the program.

This role is built to grow. As you prove yourself on flagship programs, you will take on a portfolio of projects at one or more clients, with accountability for delivery assurance, margin, client satisfaction and account growth. You will work alongside sales and solution teams to shape new work and become a trusted advisor to client executives up to C-level.

Program Managers are responsible for overseeing the project/engagement/contract/activity on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project/engagement communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.   Responsible for leading either a large contractorengagement or a definable segment of a very large and complex contractorengagement. Clients may be external or internal. PM are responsible for the translation of the clients complex business requirements into formal agreements. For these, PM establish specific solutions, applications or processes which ultimately culminate in customer acceptance of the results. This includes working with client team members and executives to identify business requirements and subsequently working with, and leading others, in the initiating, planning, controlling, executing and closing the clients solution. PM are responsible for a wide range of process activities beginning with the request for proposal through development, and final delivery.

Your Role

Program delivery

- Lead large, multi-pillar Oracle Cloud SaaS programs through all phases, from design workshops to go-live and post-implementation support

- Deliver every program on time, on budget and to agreed quality, with clear progress reporting on deliverables and milestones

- Direct onshore and offshore functional and technical teams, making sure delivery best practices are followed and work products are high quality

- Run detailed planning, effort estimation and progress tracking, and hold the team to the project plan

- Guide clients on process and configuration decisions, and drive change through negotiation and consensus-building

- Own scope, risk and change management, including raising and negotiating change requests

- Drive all client and project governance meetings, and act as the escalation point for the client

- Use AI-enabled tools and delivery accelerators to improve productivity and quality

Portfolio and commercial leadership (grows over time)

- Take on executive oversight of a portfolio of Oracle Cloud projects across one or more clients

- Own project financials, including margin, revenue and bookings forecasting, and contribution margin improvement plans

- Support delivery assurance, solution reviews and deal reviews

- Plan resource assignment and demand across the portfolio

- Build long-term client relationships and senior stakeholder trust, up to C-level

- Spot and qualify add-on opportunities in existing accounts, and help close them with sales and solution teams

- Contribute to pursuits with proposals, estimates, win themes and client presentations

- Coach and develop consultants and project managers, and help build Oracle Cloud skills across the team

- Contribute to Capgemini's Oracle Cloud community through offers, solutions, accelerators and knowledge sharing

Your Skills and Experience

- 12+ years in the Oracle applications ecosystem, including multiple full life cycle implementations

- Project or program manager on at least 5–6 Oracle Cloud (Fusion) implementations, including at least one large, multi-pillar or multi-country program

- Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud SaaS across at least two of ERP Financials, SCM, HCM, EPM and CX

- Proven record of delivering on time, on budget and to quality, with ownership of project financials and margin

- Experience leading onshore and offshore teams in global delivery models

- Strong client management, with experience working with senior and C-level stakeholders

- Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills

- Bachelor's degree in business, IT or a related field

Nice to have

- Experience overseeing several projects at once, or a portfolio within a major account

- Track record of growing revenue in existing accounts and supporting sales pursuits

- PMP, PgMP, Prince2 or Oracle Cloud certifications

- Experience using AI tools to improve delivery productivity

- Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada)

- Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada)

- Life and disability insurance

It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.
